jobs.title: Technical Product Manager - Code Quality

titleByLocale.it: Responsabile del prodotto tecnico - Codice Qualità

jobs.description:
Position description

Sonar is looking for passionate Product Managers who will make our products truly loved by developers around the world. You will be part of the Product Management team that drives the vision and roadmaps for SonarQube Cloud, SonarQube Server, and SonarQube for IDE. We are currently looking for Product Managers with a deep technical background in the field of Code Quality.

As a Product Manager, you will shape our code quality offering, ensuring that our users write more reliable and maintainable code and have a seamless experience in the product. To achieve this perfect match, we need a passionate Product Manager who will research, clarify, prioritize the needs of developers, and translate those needs across our product line. You will become an expert user of our products, from very high-level features down to technical aspects of the analysis processing.

You will join the Product Management team, which is composed of other passionate Product Managers eager to collaborate with you. You will also work closely with engaged Engineering teams to ensure that the proposed solutions meet the expected outcome and that we collectively deliver the best products to help development teams write better and more secure code. By joining us, you will bring your deep knowledge of code quality in one or many programming languages and your experience as a Product Manager to help Sonar reach the next level and provide an awesome user experience to millions of developers.

What you will do

• Contribute to the different areas of the Code Quality Product Vision and communicate about them, internally and externally.

• Research, clarify, and prioritize opportunities to build and maintain an effective roadmap.

• Interact with our users and customers on our product forum to support them, integrate their feedback, and identify opportunities.

• Develop a deep understanding of code quality and how we can enable developers to write more reliable and maintainable software.

• Work closely with other product managers to design cross-product features.

• Align with the engineering and UX teams on the problems to solve and support them during the end-to-end development stage of the solutions.

• Sync with the engineering teams to ensure that there is a good balance between innovation, consolidation, and stability.

• Attend conferences and give talks if you like.

• Help the Product Management team grow in its organization, tools, and processes.

Experience and qualifications

• Passionate about software development and the principles and practices that lead to reliable and maintainable applications.

• Deep understanding of code quality in at least one programming language or ecosystem.

• Technical comprehension of the architectures related to code scanning and static analysis

• Experience with the latest developments in AI assisted coding

• Experience in software product management, preferably in an agile context.

• Highly autonomous and pragmatic.

• Open-minded and very positive can-do attitude.

• Comfortable in dealing with change, complexity, and uncertainty.

• Self-confident enough to challenge the status quo as well as to receive feedback.

• Leadership: you take initiative and demonstrate your ability to lead a subject from beginning to end.

Benefits of Working with Sonar:

• We encourage usage of our robust time-off allocations with 27 PTO days for our employees based out of the Geneva region, plus additional days based on seniority and circumstances.

• We contribute 60% of the total cost for your pension; 13.5% to 15.5% of your base salary for savings; 2% for risk.

• Generous discretionary Company Growth Bonus, paid annually.

• Commuting:Sustainable mobility options, including carpooling and the refund of 60% of the annual transportation subscription.

• Global workforce with employees in 20+ countries representing 35+ unique nationalities.

• We have an annual kick-off somewhere in the world where we meet to build relationships and goals for the company.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione della posizione Sonar è alla ricerca di appassionati Product Manager che renderanno i nostri prodotti veramente amati dagli sviluppatori di tutto il mondo. Sarete parte del team Product Management che guida la visione e le roadmap per SonarQube Cloud, SonarQube Server e SonarQube per IDE. Siamo attualmente alla ricerca di Product Manager con un profondo background tecnico nel campo della qualità del codice. Come Product Manager, formerai la nostra offerta di qualità del codice, assicurando che i nostri utenti scrivano codice più affidabile e manutenbile e abbiano un'esperienza senza soluzione di continuità nel prodotto. Per ottenere questa corrispondenza perfetta, abbiamo bisogno di un Product Manager appassionato che cercherà, chiarirà, prioritizzerà le esigenze degli sviluppatori, e tradurre quelle esigenze attraverso la nostra linea di prodotti. Diventerai un utente esperto dei nostri prodotti, dalle caratteristiche di alto livello fino agli aspetti tecnici dell'elaborazione di analisi. Ti unirai al team Product Management, composto da altri appassionati Product Manager desiderosi di collaborare con te. Potrai anche lavorare a stretto contatto con team di ingegneria impegnati per garantire che le soluzioni proposte soddisfano il risultato previsto e che noi collettivamente fornire i migliori prodotti per aiutare i team di sviluppo a scrivere codice migliore e più sicuro. Unendoci, porterai la tua profonda conoscenza della qualità del codice in uno o più linguaggi di programmazione e la tua esperienza come Product Manager per aiutare Sonar a raggiungere il livello successivo e fornire un'esperienza utente impressionante a milioni di sviluppatori. Cosa farai
• Contribuire alle diverse aree del Code Quality Product Vision e comunicare su di loro, internamente ed esternamente.
• Ricerca, chiarimento e priorità opportunità di costruire e mantenere una roadmap efficace.
• Interagire con i nostri utenti e clienti sul nostro forum di prodotti per supportarli, integrare il loro feedback e identificare le opportunità.
• Sviluppare una profonda comprensione della qualità del codice e come possiamo consentire agli sviluppatori di scrivere software più affidabili e manutenbili.
• Lavorare a stretto contatto con altri responsabili del prodotto per progettare funzioni cross-product.
• Allineare con i team di ingegneria e UX sui problemi di risolvere e supportarli durante la fase di sviluppo end-to-end delle soluzioni.
• Sincronizza con i team di ingegneria per garantire un buon equilibrio tra innovazione, consolidamento e stabilità.
• Partecipa a conferenze e fai colloqui, se vuoi.
• Aiuta il team di Product Management a crescere nella sua organizzazione, strumenti e processi. Esperienza e qualifiche
• Passione per lo sviluppo del software e i principi e le pratiche che portano a applicazioni affidabili e manutenbili.
• Profonda comprensione della qualità del codice in almeno un linguaggio di programmazione o ecosistema.
• comprensione tecnica delle architetture relative alla scansione del codice e all'analisi statica
• Esperienza con gli ultimi sviluppi nella codifica assistita AI
• Esperienza nella gestione dei prodotti software, preferibilmente in un contesto agile.
• Altamente autonomo e pragmatico.
• Atteggiamento can-do aperto e molto positivo.
• Confortevole nel trattare il cambiamento, la complessità e l'incertezza.
• abbastanza sicuro da sfidare lo status quo e ricevere feedback.
• Leadership: prendi l'iniziativa e dimostra la tua capacità di guidare un soggetto dall'inizio alla fine. Vantaggi del lavoro con Sonar:
• Incoraggiamo l'utilizzo delle nostre robuste assegnazioni time-off con 27 giorni PTO per i nostri dipendenti con sede nella regione di Ginevra, oltre a giorni aggiuntivi basati su anzianità e circostanze.
• Contribuiamo il 60% del costo totale per la vostra pensione; il 13,5% al 15,5% del vostro stipendio base per il risparmio; il 2% per il rischio.
• Generoso discrezionale Company Growth Bonus, pagato annualmente.
• Commutazione: opzioni di mobilità sostenibile, tra cui carpooling e il rimborso del 60% dell'abbonamento annuale di trasporto.
• La forza lavoro globale con i dipendenti in 20+ paesi che rappresentano 35+ nazionalità uniche.
• Abbiamo un kick-off annuale da qualche parte nel mondo in cui ci incontriamo per costruire relazioni e obiettivi per l'azienda.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Positionsbeschreibung Sonar ist auf der Suche nach leidenschaftlichen Produktmanagern, die unsere Produkte wirklich von Entwicklern auf der ganzen Welt lieben werden. Sie werden Teil des Produktmanagement-Teams sein, das die Vision und Roadmaps für SonarQube Cloud, SonarQube Server und SonarQube for IDE vorantreibt. Wir suchen derzeit Produktmanager mit einem tiefen technischen Hintergrund im Bereich Code Quality. Als Produktmanager gestalten Sie unser Code-Qualitätsangebot und stellen sicher, dass unsere Benutzer zuverlässiger und wartbarer Code schreiben und ein nahtloses Produkterlebnis haben. Um diese perfekte Übereinstimmung zu erzielen, benötigen wir einen leidenschaftlichen Produktmanager, der die Bedürfnisse der Entwickler recherchiert, klarstellt, priorisiert und diese Bedürfnisse über unsere gesamte Produktlinie übersetzt. Sie werden ein erfahrener Benutzer unserer Produkte, von sehr hochwertigen Funktionen bis hin zu technischen Aspekten der Analyseverarbeitung. Sie werden dem Produktmanagement-Team beitreten, das sich aus anderen leidenschaftlichen Produktmanagern zusammensetzt, die mit Ihnen zusammenarbeiten möchten. Sie werden auch eng mit engagierten Engineering-Teams zusammenarbeiten, um sicherzustellen, dass die vorgeschlagenen Lösungen das erwartete Ergebnis erzielen und dass wir gemeinsam die besten Produkte liefern, die Entwicklungsteams helfen, besseren und sichereren Code zu schreiben. Wenn Sie sich uns anschließen, bringen Sie Ihr tiefes Wissen über die Codequalität in einer oder mehreren Programmiersprachen und Ihre Erfahrung als Produktmanager ein, um Sonar dabei zu helfen, die nächste Stufe zu erreichen und Millionen von Entwicklern eine großartige Benutzererfahrung zu bieten. Was du tun wirst
• Tragen Sie zu den verschiedenen Bereichen der Code Quality Product Vision bei und kommunizieren Sie intern und extern darüber.
• Recherchieren, klären und priorisieren Sie Möglichkeiten, um eine effektive Roadmap zu erstellen und zu pflegen.
• Interagieren Sie mit unseren Nutzern und Kunden in unserem Produktforum, um sie zu unterstützen, ihr Feedback zu integrieren und Chancen zu identifizieren.
• Entwickeln Sie ein tiefes Verständnis der Codequalität und wie wir es Entwicklern ermöglichen können, zuverlässigere und wartbarere Software zu schreiben.
• Arbeiten Sie eng mit anderen Produktmanagern zusammen, um produktübergreifende Funktionen zu entwerfen.
• Richten Sie sich mit den Engineering- und UX-Teams an den Problemen aus, um sie während der End-to-End-Entwicklungsphase der Lösungen zu lösen und zu unterstützen.
• Synchronisieren Sie mit den Engineering-Teams, um sicherzustellen, dass ein gutes Gleichgewicht zwischen Innovation, Konsolidierung und Stabilität besteht.
• Besuchen Sie Konferenzen und halten Sie Vorträge, wenn Sie möchten.
• Helfen Sie dem Produktmanagement-Team, in seiner Organisation, seinen Tools und Prozessen zu wachsen. Erfahrung und Qualifikationen
• Leidenschaft für Softwareentwicklung und die Prinzipien und Praktiken, die zu zuverlässigen und wartbaren Anwendungen führen.
• Tiefes Verständnis der Codequalität in mindestens einer Programmiersprache oder einem Ökosystem.
• Technisches Verständnis der Architekturen im Zusammenhang mit Code-Scanning und statischer Analyse
• Erfahrung mit den neuesten Entwicklungen in der KI-unterstützten Codierung
• Erfahrung im Software-Produktmanagement, vorzugsweise im agilen Kontext.
• Höchst autonom und pragmatisch.
• Aufgeschlossene und sehr positive Can-Do-Haltung.
• Bequem im Umgang mit Veränderung, Komplexität und Unsicherheit.
• Selbstsicher genug, um den Status quo herauszufordern und Feedback zu erhalten.
• Führung: Sie ergreifen Initiative und zeigen Ihre Fähigkeit, ein Thema von Anfang bis Ende zu führen. Vorteile der Arbeit mit Sonar:
• Wir empfehlen die Nutzung unserer robusten Freizeitzuweisungen mit 27 PTO-Tagen für unsere Mitarbeiter aus der Region Genf sowie zusätzliche Tage je nach Dienstalter und Umständen.
• Wir tragen 60% der Gesamtkosten für Ihre Rente bei; 13,5 % bis 15,5 % Ihres Grundgehalts für Einsparungen; 2 % für das Risiko.
• Großzügiger diskretionärer Unternehmenswachstumsbonus, jährlich gezahlt.
• Pendeln: Nachhaltige Mobilitätsoptionen, einschließlich Fahrgemeinschaften und die Rückerstattung von 60% des jährlichen Transportabonnements.
• Weltweite Belegschaft mit Mitarbeitern in 20+ Ländern, die 35+ einzigartige Nationalitäten repräsentieren.
• Wir haben einen jährlichen Kick-Off irgendwo auf der Welt, wo wir uns treffen, um Beziehungen und Ziele für das Unternehmen aufzubauen.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Description de la position Sonar est à la recherche de Product Managers passionnés qui feront de nos produits vraiment aimés par les développeurs du monde entier. Vous ferez partie de l'équipe de gestion des produits qui pilote la vision et les feuilles de route pour SonarQube Cloud, SonarQube Server et SonarQube pour IDE. Nous sommes actuellement à la recherche de Product Managers avec un fond technique profond dans le domaine de la qualité de code. En tant que gestionnaire de produit, vous façonnerez notre offre de qualité de code, en veillant à ce que nos utilisateurs écrivent un code plus fiable et durable et aient une expérience transparente dans le produit. Pour parvenir à cette correspondance parfaite, nous avons besoin d'un gestionnaire de produits passionné qui recherchera, clarifiera, priorisera les besoins des développeurs et traduira ces besoins dans toute notre gamme de produits. Vous deviendrez un utilisateur expert de nos produits, des caractéristiques de très haut niveau jusqu'aux aspects techniques du traitement d'analyse. Vous rejoindrez l'équipe de gestion des produits, composée d'autres chefs de produits passionnés désireux de collaborer avec vous. Vous travaillerez également en étroite collaboration avec les équipes d'ingénierie engagées pour s'assurer que les solutions proposées répondent aux résultats escomptés et que nous livrons collectivement les meilleurs produits pour aider les équipes de développement à rédiger un code meilleur et plus sûr. En vous joignant à nous, vous apporterez votre connaissance approfondie de la qualité du code dans un ou plusieurs langages de programmation et votre expérience en tant que gestionnaire de produits pour aider Sonar à atteindre le niveau suivant et fournir une expérience utilisateur formidable à des millions de développeurs. Ce que vous ferez
• Contribuer aux différents domaines de la Vision des produits de qualité du Code et communiquer à leur sujet, à l'interne et à l'externe.
• Recherche, clarification et hiérarchisation des occasions d'élaborer et de maintenir une feuille de route efficace.
• Interagir avec nos utilisateurs et nos clients sur notre forum de produits pour les soutenir, intégrer leurs commentaires et identifier les opportunités.
• Développer une compréhension profonde de la qualité du code et comment nous pouvons permettre aux développeurs d'écrire des logiciels plus fiables et plus durables.
• Travailler en étroite collaboration avec d'autres gestionnaires de produits pour concevoir des caractéristiques de produits croisés.
• Alignez-vous avec les équipes d'ingénierie et d'UX sur les problèmes à résoudre et à soutenir pendant la phase de développement de bout en bout des solutions.
• Synchroniser avec les équipes d'ingénierie pour assurer un bon équilibre entre innovation, consolidation et stabilité.
• Assister à des conférences et donner des conférences si vous voulez.
• Aider l'équipe de gestion des produits à croître dans son organisation, ses outils et ses processus. Expérience et qualifications
• Passionné par le développement de logiciels et les principes et pratiques qui conduisent à des applications fiables et durables.
• Connaissance approfondie de la qualité du code dans au moins un langage de programmation ou un écosystème.
• Compréhension technique des architectures liées à la numérisation de code et à l'analyse statique
• Expérience des derniers développements en matière de codage assisté par AI
• Expérience dans la gestion de produits logiciels, de préférence dans un contexte agile.
• Très autonome et pragmatique.
• Une attitude ouverte et très positive.
• Confortable face au changement, à la complexité et à l'incertitude.
• Auto-confident suffisamment pour contester le statu quo ainsi que pour recevoir des commentaires.
• Leadership : vous prenez des initiatives et démontrez votre capacité à diriger un sujet du début à la fin. Avantages de travailler avec Sonar :
• Nous encourageons l'utilisation de nos allocations de congés robustes avec 27 jours de PTO pour nos employés basés à Genève, ainsi que des jours supplémentaires en fonction de l'ancienneté et des circonstances.
• Nous cotisons 60 % du coût total de votre pension; 13,5 % à 15,5 % de votre salaire de base pour l'épargne; 2 % pour le risque.
• Généreux bonus de croissance discrétionnaire de l'entreprise, payé annuellement.
• Déplacement: options de mobilité durable, y compris le covoiturage et le remboursement de 60% de l'abonnement annuel au transport.
• Main-d'œuvre mondiale avec des employés dans plus de 20 pays représentant plus de 35 nationalités uniques.
• Nous avons un lancement annuel quelque part dans le monde où nous nous rencontrons pour établir des relations et des objectifs pour l'entreprise.

jobs.title: Technical Account Manager (Technical Advisory)
jobs.description:
Who is Sonar?

Sonar is driving the future of agent-centric software development. As the leader in AI code review and verification, we solve a critical problem: ensuring that software generated by AI-assisted developers or autonomous agents is reliable, secure, and maintainable.

Integrating seamlessly with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, and Devin, we help over 75% of the Fortune 100 build trusted, reliable, compliant software. Customers who use Sonar are 44% less likely to report an outage due to AI-generated code.

We believe code verification is the critical missing link in the Agent-Centric Development Cycle (AC/DC). Industry giants like Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company count on us to provide independent, explainable, consistent review and governance of their AI-generated code via products like:

•
 SonarQube: The world’s leading AI code review and verification platform.

•
 SonarQube Foundation Agent: Currently topping the leaderboards for agentic software repair.

•
 SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Providing the enterprise-grade context and constraints agents need to be truly effective.

Our team operates across global hubs in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Geneva, London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Washington D.C. We move with a mindset we call CODE:

•
 Committed to our customers and community.

•
 Obsessed with quality.

•
 Deliberate in our decisions.

•
 Effective as one team.

With over $400M in revenue and profitable, fast-paced growth, we are building the backbone of the AI software revolution. If you’re hungry to have an impact, want to build at a fast pace, and ready to work at the forefront of AI, we want to hear from you.

The impact you will have

• Grow the usage of the Sonar solution within Accounts

• Increase the overall Account Sonar maturity

• Lower the risk of Account churn or downgrade

• Increase Account satisfaction, reduce the number of escalations

• Increase the number of Sonar sponsors in the Account

• Establish and maintain Sonar as a Trusted Advisor in the Account

• Entice Accounts to stay current on an Active version of Sonar, to get maximal value

• Influence Sonar roadmap to meet Account needs

On a daily basis, you will

• Actively listen and formalize Account technical pains or other adoption inhibitors

• Work on plans to overcome customer pains and inhibitors

• Report product technical or functional gaps internally and advocate for their resolution

• Evangelize/Promote the Sonar methodology to govern continuous Code Quality and Security improvements to the customer

• Assist Sonar sponsors in the Account for the promotion/evangelization of the Sonar ecosystem

• Keep Accounts up to date on the roadmap and aware of the value present in upcoming Sonar releases, as well as collecting feedback

• Recruit customer development teams not currently using Sonar “Upgrade” customer development teams that do not use Sonar correctly and therefore do not receive the maximum value

• Position (favorably) the Sonar ecosystem vs other competing products potentially still used in the Account

• Educate developers and managers on the value of static code analysis in general and of the Sonar ecosystem specifically

• Make sure that the Account's Sonar technical deployment and operations are in line with the size of the deployment and the criticality of the tool in the DevOps chain

• Run Quarterly Business Reviews (QBR) with Account Sales representatives

• Execute Sonar deployment audits, identify gaps, and drive remediation plans for Accounts

• Contribute to the Account Management plans with Sales Representatives. Elaborate the Technical strategy tailored to the Account context, provide inputs on the Commercial strategy

• Keep yourself constantly up to date knowledge of the technical status of the Account, technical progress, threats, and opportunities for improved maturity

• Track product development within Sonar in order to maintain product expertise

The skills you will demonstrate

• Proven practical experience (at least 5 years) in software development or DevOps engineering which sets the stage for understanding our products and how they’re enjoyed by users

• At least 5 years of experience in pre- or post-sales customer-facing activities

• High listening skills and the ability to formalize and abstract elements expressed by customers and partners

• Excellent presentation skills with strong written and verbal communication skills

• Proven ability to work in a team, receiving and giving feedback as well as sharing knowledge

• Attention to details

• A can-do attitude: challenging the status quo, leading and contributing to key improvements and innovationsAutonomy to run your activity/plans with limited supervision

We value diversity, equity, and inclusion

At Sonar, we believe that our diversity is our strength. We are a global company that values and respects different backgrounds, perspectives, and cultures. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome all qualified applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

If you need any accommodation, please reach out to us at hiring@sonarsource.com .

All offers of employment at Sonar are contingent upon the results of a comprehensive background check and reference verification conducted before the start date.

Applications that are submitted through agencies or third party recruiters will not be considered.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Who is Sonar?

Sonar is driving the future of agent-centric software development. As the leader in AI code review and verification, we solve a critical problem: ensuring that software generated by AI-assisted developers or autonomous agents is reliable, secure, and maintainable.

Integrating seamlessly with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, and Devin, we help over 75% of the Fortune 100 build trusted, reliable, compliant software. Customers who use Sonar are 44% less likely to report an outage due to AI-generated code.

We believe code verification is the critical missing link in the Agent-Centric Development Cycle (AC/DC). Industry giants like Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company count on us to provide independent, explainable, consistent review and governance of their AI-generated code via products like:

•
SonarQube: The world’s leading AI code review and verification platform.

•
SonarQube Foundation Agent: Currently topping the leaderboards for agentic software repair.

•
SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Providing the enterprise-grade context and constraints agents need to be truly effective.

Our team operates across global hubs in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Geneva, London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Washington D.C. We move with a mindset we call CODE:

•
Committed to our customers and community.

•
Obsessed with quality.

•
Deliberate in our decisions.

•
Effective as one team.

With over $400M in revenue and profitable, fast-paced growth, we are building the backbone of the AI software revolution. If you’re hungry to have an impact, want to build at a fast pace, and ready to work at the forefront of AI, we want to hear from you.

The impact you will have

• Grow the usage of the Sonar solution within Accounts

• Increase the overall Account Sonar maturity

• Lower the risk of Account churn or downgrade

• Increase Account satisfaction, reduce the number of escalations

• Increase the number of Sonar sponsors in the Account

• Establish and maintain Sonar as a Trusted Advisor in the Account

• Entice Accounts to stay current on an Active version of Sonar, to get maximal value

• Influence Sonar roadmap to meet Account needs

On a daily basis, you will

• Actively listen and formalize Account technical pains or other adoption inhibitors

• Work on plans to overcome customer pains and inhibitors

• Report product technical or functional gaps internally and advocate for their resolution

• Evangelize/Promote the Sonar methodology to govern continuous Code Quality and Security improvements to the customer

• Assist Sonar sponsors in the Account for the promotion/evangelization of the Sonar ecosystem

• Keep Accounts up to date on the roadmap and aware of the value present in upcoming Sonar releases, as well as collecting feedback

• Recruit customer development teams not currently using Sonar “Upgrade” customer development teams that do not use Sonar correctly and therefore do not receive the maximum value

• Position (favorably) the Sonar ecosystem vs other competing products potentially still used in the Account

• Educate developers and managers on the value of static code analysis in general and of the Sonar ecosystem specifically

• Make sure that the Account's Sonar technical deployment and operations are in line with the size of the deployment and the criticality of the tool in the DevOps chain

• Run Quarterly Business Reviews (QBR) with Account Sales representatives

• Execute Sonar deployment audits, identify gaps, and drive remediation plans for Accounts

• Contribute to the Account Management plans with Sales Representatives. Elaborate the Technical strategy tailored to the Account context, provide inputs on the Commercial strategy

• Keep yourself constantly up to date knowledge of the technical status of the Account, technical progress, threats, and opportunities for improved maturity

• Track product development within Sonar in order to maintain product expertise

The skills you will demonstrate

• Proven practical experience (at least 5 years) in software development or DevOps engineering which sets the stage for understanding our products and how they’re enjoyed by users

• At least 5 years of experience in pre- or post-sales customer-facing activities

• High listening skills and the ability to formalize and abstract elements expressed by customers and partners

• Excellent presentation skills with strong written and verbal communication skills

• Proven ability to work in a team, receiving and giving feedback as well as sharing knowledge

• Attention to details

We value diversity, equity, and inclusion

descriptionByLocale.en:
Who is Sonar?

Sonar is driving the future of agent-centric software development. As the leader in AI code verification and governance, we solve a critical problem: ensuring that software generated by AI-assisted developers or autonomous agents is reliable, secure, and maintainable.

Integrating seamlessly with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, and Devin, we help over 75% of the Fortune 100 build trusted, reliable, compliant software. Customers who use Sonar are 44% less likely to report an outage due to AI-generated code.

We believe code verification is the critical missing link in the Agent-Centric Development Cycle (AC/DC). Industry giants like Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company count on us to provide independent, explainable, consistent review and governance of their AI-generated code via products like:

• SonarQube: The world’s leading AI code review and verification platform.

• SonarQube Foundation Agent: Currently topping the leaderboards for agentic software repair.

• SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Providing the enterprise-grade context and constraints agents need to be truly effective.

Our team operates across global hubs in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Geneva, London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Washington D.C. We move with a mindset we call CODE:

• Committed to our customers and community.

• Obsessed with quality.

• Deliberate in our decisions.

• Effective as one team.

With over $400M in revenue and profitable, fast-paced growth, we are building the backbone of the AI software revolution. If you’re hungry to have an impact, want to build at a fast pace, and ready to work at the forefront of AI, we want to hear from you.

Position description

To sustain the growth of our customer portfolio and to extend our services offering, we are looking for a Support Engineer. On top of joining a fast-growing and innovative company, you will have the opportunity to assist our customers around the world in deploying/using our solutions and adopting software engineering best practices as a whole.

As a Support Engineer, you will contribute to Sonar products adoption and integration. You will provide an individualized level of service to our customers. You will guide them in finding the right implementation and advocate the best way to use our products. You will also investigate and solve customer issues in a timely manner. In Sonar, you will represent the customer voice in product discussions.

What you will do

•
Help customers integrate our solutions across their development pipeline. It means helping with the technical integration with developer IDE, ALMs, and Continuous Integration chain; the integration to software lifecycle (SCM, build, test), and the integration to existing business applications (identity provider, database, etc.).

•
Drive technical issues to resolution: from the qualification of customer concerns to conducting an in-depth technical investigation and managing customer relationships all along the way.

•
Collaborate with Sales and Consultants to improve overall customer experience and make sure that our Service offering brings maximum value to our customers.

•
Work with the rest of the team to listen, challenge, and refine customers feedback to feed discussions with product teams and shape product evolutions.

•
Have a voice in enhancing the way we work.

Experience and qualifications

•
Software engineering best practices, with at least 3-5 years of experience in supporting, or maintaining and delivering high-quality software.

•
2+ years experience using or administrating a DevOps pipeline: SCM (e.g. Git, SVN), IDE (e.g. Visual Studio, IntelliJ), CI (e.g. Jenkins Pipelines, Azure DevOps, BitBucket, GitLab). More than acronyms, these are the tools that our customers use and that our products integrate with.

Demonstrated curiosity and practical experience using AI tools in development, troubleshooting or workflow optimization

•
​​Working knowledge of both local and cloud-based software deployment platforms and technologies, including Linux, Windows, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, Azure

•
Investigation skills to understand problems in their context and the ability to reproduce these scenarios.

•
Team player, receiving and giving feedback as well as sharing knowledge.

•
Can-do attitude: challenging status quo, leading and contributing to key improvements and innovations.

•
Excellent English, verbal/written communication skills

In-office culture

We're intentional about this. We believe the best teams are built in the room together. Three anchor days — Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays — create the collaboration rhythm that makes a hub office worth having.

Candidates need to be genuinely based in the location the role is posted — if that's not where you are today, we're happy to support relocation for the right person.

At Sonar, we believe that our diversity is our strength. We are a global company that values and respects different backgrounds, perspectives, and cultures. Come Staff Engineer, sarete l'architetto di soluzioni di identità robuste, scalabili e altamente sicure che colmano senza soluzione di continuità le nostre offerte cloud e autogestite. Come ingegnere del personale si svolgerà anche un ruolo cruciale nella mentoring altri ingegneri, aiutandoli a crescere le loro abilità e espandere il loro impatto.

Potrai collaborare a stretto contatto con Product Managers, Engineering Managers e altri ingegneri Staff/Principal in tutta l'organizzazione per condurre la consegna end-to-end di caratteristiche di identità critiche. Cosa farai

Architetto e guida la progettazione delle nostre applicazioni cloud on-premises e AWS.

Controllare l'implementazione delle funzionalità, il monitoraggio della produzione e risolvere problemi dal vivo specifici del team.

Prove capacità di prendere iniziativa e portare un soggetto che coinvolge diversi stakeholder e ingegneri a completamento con poco o nessun supervisione.

Esperienza di supporto e mentoring altri membri del team.

Proficienza con Java accoppiato con una forte passione per Clean Code e rigorosi standard di qualità software.

•
Esperienza di progettazione applicazioni cloud-native.

•
Esperienza con RDBMS relazionali (come Postgres) e SQL.

•
Competenze di dominio in Identity and Access Management (IAM), tra cui esperienza pratica con protocolli AuthN/AuthZ (OAuth2, OIDC, SAML, JWT) e provisioning degli utenti (SCIM).

Capacità di lavorare con e sterzare gli strumenti di codifica AI (Codex, Claude, ecc).

Cultura in ufficio

Siamo intenzionali. Crediamo che le migliori squadre siano costruite nella stanza insieme. Tre giorni di ancora — lunedì, martedì e giovedì — creano il ritmo di collaborazione che rende un hub office degno di avere.

I candidati devono essere autenticamente basati nel luogo in cui il ruolo è pubblicato — se non è lì che sei oggi, siamo lieti di sostenere la delocalizzazione per la persona giusta.

Valoriamo la diversità, l'equità e l'inclusione

A Sonar, crediamo che la nostra diversità sia la nostra forza. Siamo una società globale che valorizza e rispetta diversi sfondi, prospettive e culture. Ci impegniamo a promuovere un ambiente di lavoro diversificato e inclusivo in cui tutti si sentono valorizzati e potenziati per contribuire al meglio. Siamo orgogliosi di essere un datore di lavoro pari opportunità e di accogliere tutti i candidati qualificati, indipendentemente da razza, colore, religione, sesso, identità di genere o espressione, orientamento sessuale, origine nazionale, genetica, disabilità, età, o stato veterano.

Se avete bisogno di un alloggio, contattateci all'indirizzo hiring@sonarsource.com .

Tutte le offerte di lavoro a Sonar sono contingenti sui risultati di un controllo completo di sfondo e verifica di riferimento effettuato prima della data di inizio.

descriptionByLocale.en:
Who is Sonar?

Sonar is driving the future of agent-centric software development. As the leader in AI code verification and governance, we solve a critical problem: ensuring that software generated by AI-assisted developers or autonomous agents is reliable, secure, and maintainable.

Integrating seamlessly with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, and Devin, we help over 75% of the Fortune 100 build trusted, reliable, compliant software. Customers who use Sonar are 44% less likely to report an outage due to AI-generated code.

We believe code verification is the critical missing link in the Agent-Centric Development Cycle (AC/DC). Industry giants like Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company count on us to provide independent, explainable, consistent review and governance of their AI-generated code via products like:

• SonarQube: The world’s leading AI code review and verification platform.

• SonarQube Foundation Agent: Currently topping the leaderboards for agentic software repair.

• SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Providing the enterprise-grade context and constraints agents need to be truly effective.

Our team operates across global hubs in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Geneva, London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Washington D.C. We move with a mindset we call CODE:

• Committed to our customers and community.

• Obsessed with quality.

• Deliberate in our decisions.

• Effective as one team.

With over $400M in revenue and profitable, fast-paced growth, we are building the backbone of the AI software revolution. If you’re hungry to have an impact, want to build at a fast pace, and ready to work at the forefront of AI, we want to hear from you.

Position description
We are looking for a highly impactful Staff Engineer to join the Identity Squad within our StoreFront department .

The Identity squad is the cornerstone of trust and access across Sonar's product ecosystem. The squad is responsible for everything related to authentication (AuthN) and authorization (AuthZ) for all of Sonar’s products. We operate services at scale, handling 1000s of requests per second. As a Staff Engineer, you will be architecting robust, scalable, and highly secure identity solutions that seamlessly bridge our cloud and self-managed offerings. As a Staff engineer you will also play a crucial role in mentoring other engineers, helping them grow their skills and expand their impact.

You will partner closely with Product Managers, Engineering Managers, and other Staff/Principal Engineers across the organization to lead the end-to-end delivery of critical identity features. You will take ownership—from initial architecture and design through to implementation and deployment—of major initiatives ensuring a frictionless yet highly secure experience for millions of developers.

What you will do

•
Collaborate with UX designers, Product Management, and engineering teams to deliver robust security features alongside an optimal user experience.

•
Take strong ownership of squad deliverables and effectively drive sprints toward successful completion.

•
Architect and guide the design of our on-premises and AWS cloud applications.

•
Oversee feature deployment, production monitoring, and troubleshoot team-specific live issues.

•
Mentor engineering team members to help them grow in their technical responsibilities and remove blockers to their autonomy.

•
Contribute to the definition of the team’s short and long-term goals.

Experience and qualifications

•
Over 8 years of software engineering experience, including working as a Tech Lead, Staff Engineer, or Software Architect.

•
Proven ability to take initiative and bring a subject involving several stakeholders and engineers to completion with little to no supervision.

•
Experience supporting and mentoring other team members.

•
Proficiency with Java coupled with a strong passion for Clean Code and rigorous software quality standards.

•
Experience architecting cloud-native applications.

•
Experience with relational RDBMS (such as Postgres) and SQL.

•
Domain expertise in Identity and Access Management (IAM), including hands-on experience with AuthN/AuthZ protocols (OAuth2, OIDC, SAML, JWT) and user provisioning (SCIM).

•
Proficiency in working with and steering AI coding tools (Codex, Claude, etc).

In-office culture

We're intentional about this. We believe the best teams are built in the room together. Three anchor days — Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays — create the collaboration rhythm that makes a hub office worth having.

Candidates need to be genuinely based in the location the role is posted — if that's not where you are today, we're happy to support relocation for the right person.

We value diversity, equity, and inclusion

At Sonar, we believe that our diversity is our strength. We are a global company that values and respects different backgrounds, perspectives, and cultures. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome all qualified applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

If you need any accommodation, please reach out to us at hiring@sonarsource.com .

All offers of employment at Sonar are contingent upon the results of a comprehensive background check and reference verification conducted before the start date.

Applications that are submitted through agencies or third party recruiters will not be considered.

Nous sommes à la recherche d'un ingénieur du personnel hautement impacté pour rejoindre l'équipe d'identité au sein de notre département StoreFront .

S'approprier fortement les produits livrables des équipes et conduire efficacement les sprints vers une réussite.

Architecte et guide la conception de nos applications cloud sur site et AWS.

Surveiller le déploiement des fonctions, le suivi de la production et les problèmes de dépannage propres à l'équipe.

Les membres de l'équipe d'ingénierie Mentor pour les aider à développer leurs responsabilités techniques et de supprimer les bloqueurs à leur autonomie.

Capacité éprouvée de prendre des initiatives et d'amener un sujet impliquant plusieurs intervenants et ingénieurs à l'achèvement avec peu ou pas de supervision.

•
Expérience de soutien et de mentorat d'autres membres de l'équipe.

•
Compétence avec Java associée à une forte passion pour Clean Code et des normes rigoureuses de qualité des logiciels.

•
Découvrez l'architecture des applications cloud-native.

•
Expérience avec RDBMS relationnel (comme Postgres) et SQL.

•
Expertise en gestion d'identité et d'accès (IAM), y compris expérience pratique avec les protocoles AuthN/AuthZ (OAuth2, OIDC, SAML, JWT) et fourniture par les utilisateurs (SCIM).

Compétence dans le travail et le pilotage des outils de codage AI (Codex, Claude, etc.).

On est intentionnels. Nous croyons que les meilleures équipes sont construites dans la pièce ensemble. Trois jours d'ancrage — les lundis, les mardis et les jeudis — créent le rythme de collaboration qui rend un bureau central intéressant.

Chi è Sonar?

Sonar sta guidando il futuro dello sviluppo software incentrato sugli agenti. In qualità di leader nella verifica e governance del codice AI, risolviamo un problema critico: garantire che il software generato da sviluppatori assistiti dall'intelligenza artificiale o agenti autonomi sia affidabile, sicuro e manutenibile.

Grazie alla perfetta integrazione con Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini e Devin, aiutiamo oltre il 75% delle aziende Fortune 100 a creare software attendibili, affidabili e conformi. I clienti che utilizzano Sonar hanno il 44% di probabilità in meno di segnalare un'interruzione dovuta al codice generato dall'intelligenza artificiale.

Riteniamo che la verifica del codice sia l'anello mancante fondamentale nel ciclo di sviluppo incentrato sull'agente (AC/DC). Giganti del settore come Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca e Ford Motor Company contano su di noi per fornire una revisione e una governance indipendenti, spiegabili e coerenti del loro codice generato dall'intelligenza artificiale tramite prodotti come:

• SonarQube: la piattaforma leader a livello mondiale per la revisione e la verifica dei codici AI.

• SonarQube Foundation Agent: attualmente in cima alle classifiche per la riparazione di software tramite agenti.

• SonarSweep e potenziamento del contesto Sonar: fornire il contesto e i vincoli di livello aziendale di cui gli agenti hanno bisogno per essere veramente efficaci.

Il nostro team opera negli hub globali di Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Ginevra, Londra, Singapore, Tokyo e Washington D.C. Ci muoviamo con una mentalità che chiamiamo CODICE:

• Impegnati nei confronti dei nostri clienti e della comunità.

• Ossessionato dalla qualità.

• Deliberato nelle nostre decisioni.

• Efficace come una squadra.

Con oltre 400 milioni di dollari di fatturato e una crescita rapida e redditizia, stiamo costruendo la spina dorsale della rivoluzione del software AI. Vogliamo prendere le migliori decisioni possibili per i nostri prodotti e per farlo dobbiamo prendere decisioni basate sui dati.

Per raggiungere questo obiettivo, stiamo cercando un Data Engineer di talento: tu! - per entrare a far parte del team Data & ML Platform.

Insieme, renderemo i prodotti Sonar la soluzione indiscussa di correzione del codice leader a livello mondiale!

Cosa farai
Progetterai e svilupperai la piattaforma dati per supportare i domini funzionali nella gestione dei loro dati e aiutarli nel loro percorso verso la proprietà dei dati. Ciò significa:

• Migliorare continuamente la piattaforma dati. Proporre, implementare e gestire servizi di gestione dei dati in base alle esigenze delle parti interessate (responsabili di prodotto, marketing, vendite, team di ingegneria, ...)

• Stabilire pipeline end-to-end di altissimo livello, inclusa la pulizia e la modellazione dei dati.

• Sviluppare e distribuire connettori alle origini dati di interesse.

• Mantenere la documentazione sempre aggiornata del flusso di dati tra i sistemi.

• Collaborare sulla governance dei dati con altri stakeholder/domini.

• Collaborare con la funzione di sicurezza per garantire il rispetto degli standard di sicurezza previsti.

• Collaborare con il responsabile dell'incidente per apportare la propria esperienza quando richiesto e implementare autonomamente le raccomandazioni dell'autopsia.

Esperienza e qualifiche

Hai una solida esperienza nell'ingegneria del software, concentrandoti sullo sviluppo di pipeline di ingegneria dei dati e sull'archiviazione nel cloud. Sei stato esposto agli elementi essenziali dell'architettura dei Big Data, allo streaming, ai batch ETL, all'amministrazione dell'archivio dati,...

•
Ti vedi come uno sviluppatore che lavora sui dati. Sei motivato sia dagli aspetti tecnici che funzionali dei servizi.

•
Sei un giocatore di squadra amichevole, entusiasta e organizzato. Condividi attivamente le tue conoscenze e dai e ricevi feedback per migliorare te stesso e il team.

•
Forte esperienza nella creazione di pipeline ETLT, ETL o ELT end-to-end con tecnologie batch o streaming in Python.

•
L'esperienza di lavoro con Databricks come piattaforma o la creazione di pipeline di dati con PySpark è un vantaggio.

•
Forte esperienza con la piattaforma AWS inclusi, ma non limitati a, servizi come: Glue, RedShift, CloudFormation, S3, CloudWatch, Lambdas, ecc... o equivalenti

•
Buona conoscenza dei concetti di ingegneria dei dati (Data Lake, Data Warehouse, ecc…)

•
Esperienza con gli strumenti Infrastructure as code (CDK, CloudFormation, Terraform)

•
Parli fluentemente l'inglese, sia scritto che parlato

Wer ist Sonar?

Sonar treibt die Zukunft der agentenzentrierten Softwareentwicklung voran. Als führender Anbieter von KI-Codeverifizierung und -Governance lösen wir ein kritisches Problem: Wir stellen sicher, dass von KI-unterstützten Entwicklern oder autonomen Agenten generierte Software zuverlässig, sicher und wartbar ist.

Durch die nahtlose Integration mit Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini und Devin helfen wir über 75 % der Fortune 100 bei der Entwicklung vertrauenswürdiger, zuverlässiger und konformer Software. Bei Kunden, die Sonar verwenden, ist die Wahrscheinlichkeit, dass sie einen Ausfall aufgrund von KI-generiertem Code melden, um 44 % geringer.

Wir glauben, dass die Codeüberprüfung das entscheidende fehlende Glied im Agent-Centric Development Cycle (AC/DC) ist. Branchenriesen wie Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca und Ford Motor Company verlassen sich darauf, dass wir eine unabhängige, erklärbare, konsistente Überprüfung und Steuerung ihres KI-generierten Codes bieten, und zwar über Produkte wie:

• SonarQube: Die weltweit führende Plattform zur Überprüfung und Verifizierung von KI-Code.

• SonarQube Foundation Agent: Derzeit an der Spitze der Bestenlisten für die Reparatur von Agent-Software.

• SonarSweep und Sonar-Kontexterweiterung: Bereitstellung des Kontexts und der Einschränkungen auf Unternehmensniveau, die Agenten benötigen, um wirklich effektiv zu sein.

Unser Team ist an globalen Standorten in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Genf, London, Singapur, Tokio und Washington D.C. tätig. Wir bewegen uns mit einer Denkweise, die wir CODE nennen:

• Wir engagieren uns für unsere Kunden und die Gemeinschaft.

• Besessen von Qualität.

• Wir treffen unsere Entscheidungen bewusst.

• Effektiv als ein Team.

Mit einem Umsatz von über 400 Millionen US-Dollar und einem profitablen, rasanten Wachstum bilden wir das Rückgrat der KI-Software-Revolution. Wenn Sie Lust haben, etwas zu bewirken, schnell aufbauen möchten und bereit sind, an der Spitze der KI zu arbeiten, möchten wir von Ihnen hören.

Wir wollen die bestmöglichen Entscheidungen für unsere Produkte treffen und dafür müssen wir datengesteuerte Entscheidungen treffen.

Um dieses Ziel zu erreichen, suchen wir einen talentierten Data Engineer – Sie! - um dem Data & ML Platform-Team beizutreten.

Sie entwerfen und entwickeln die Datenplattform, um die Funktionsbereiche beim Umgang mit ihren Daten zu unterstützen und ihnen auf ihrem Weg zum Dateneigentum zu helfen. Das bedeutet:

• Kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung der Datenplattform. Vorschlagen, Implementieren und Verwalten von Datenverarbeitungsdiensten entsprechend den Bedürfnissen der Stakeholder (Produktmanager, Marketing, Vertrieb, Ingenieurteams usw.)

• Etablieren Sie erstklassige End-to-End-Pipelines inklusive Datenbereinigung und -modellierung.

• Konnektoren für interessante Datenquellen entwickeln und bereitstellen.

• Pflegen Sie eine stets gültige Dokumentation des Datenflusses über alle Systeme hinweg.

• Arbeiten Sie bei der Datenverwaltung mit anderen Stakeholdern/Domänen zusammen.

• Arbeiten Sie mit der Sicherheitsfunktion zusammen, um sicherzustellen, dass wir die erwarteten Sicherheitsstandards einhalten.

• Arbeiten Sie mit dem Vorfallmanager zusammen, um bei Bedarf Ihr Fachwissen einzubringen und die Empfehlungen aus Obduktionen selbst umzusetzen.

•
Sie verstehen sich als Entwickler, der an Daten arbeitet. Sie sind sowohl von technischen als auch von funktionalen Aspekten von Dienstleistungen motiviert.

•
Sie sind ein freundlicher, enthusiastischer und organisierter Teamplayer. Sie teilen Ihr Wissen aktiv und geben und erhalten Feedback, um das Team und sich selbst zu verbessern.

Umfangreiche Erfahrung im Aufbau von End-to-End-ETLT-, ETL- oder ELT-Pipelines mit Batch- oder Streaming-Technologien in Python.

•
Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit Databricks als Plattform oder im Aufbau von Datenpipelines mit PySpark ist von Vorteil.

•
Umfangreiche Erfahrung mit der AWS-Plattform, einschließlich, aber nicht beschränkt auf Dienste wie: Glue, RedShift, CloudFormation, S3, CloudWatch, Lambdas usw. oder Äquivalente

•
Gute Kenntnisse von Data-Engineering-Konzepten (Data Lake, Data Warehouse usw.)

•
Erfahrung mit Infrastructure-as-Code-Tools (CDK, CloudFormation, Terraform)

•
Sie sprechen fließend Englisch in Wort und Schrift

Qui est Sonar ?

Sonar est le moteur de l'avenir du développement de logiciels centrés sur les agents. En tant que leader de la vérification et de la gouvernance du code de l'IA, nous résolvons un problème critique : garantir que les logiciels générés par des développeurs assistés par l'IA ou des agents autonomes sont fiables, sécurisés et maintenables.

En nous intégrant parfaitement à Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini et Devin, nous aidons plus de 75 % des entreprises Fortune 100 à créer des logiciels fiables et conformes. Les clients qui utilisent Sonar sont 44 % moins susceptibles de signaler une panne due au code généré par l'IA.

Nous pensons que la vérification du code est le chaînon manquant essentiel dans le cycle de développement centré sur les agents (AC/DC). Des géants de l'industrie comme Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca et Ford Motor Company comptent sur nous pour fournir une évaluation et une gouvernance indépendantes, explicables et cohérentes de leur code généré par l'IA via des produits tels que :

• SonarQube : la première plateforme mondiale d'examen et de vérification de codes d'IA.

• SonarQube Foundation Agent : actuellement en tête des classements pour la réparation de logiciels agents.

• SonarSweep et Sonar Context Augmentation : fournir le contexte et les contraintes de niveau entreprise dont les agents ont besoin pour être vraiment efficaces.

Notre équipe opère dans des centres mondiaux à Austin, Bochum, Dubaï, Genève, Londres, Singapour, Tokyo et Washington D.C. Nous évoluons avec un état d'esprit que nous appelons CODE :

• Engagé envers nos clients et notre communauté.

• Obsédé par la qualité.

• Délibérer dans nos décisions.

• Efficace en équipe.

Avec plus de 400 millions de dollars de chiffre d’affaires et une croissance rentable et rapide, nous construisons l’épine dorsale de la révolution logicielle de l’IA. Si vous avez envie d’avoir un impact, souhaitez construire à un rythme rapide et êtes prêt à travailler à la pointe de l’IA, nous voulons avoir de vos nouvelles.

Description du poste :

Nous voulons prendre les meilleures décisions possibles pour nos produits et pour ce faire, nous devons prendre des décisions fondées sur des données.

Pour atteindre cet objectif, nous recherchons un Data Engineer talentueux - vous ! - de rejoindre l'équipe Data & ML Platform.

Ensemble, nous ferons des produits Sonar la solution incontestée de remédiation de code de premier plan au monde !

Ce que tu feras
Vous concevrez et développerez la plateforme de données pour soutenir les domaines fonctionnels dans la gestion de leurs données et les aider dans leur cheminement vers la propriété des données. Cela signifie :

• Concevoir et mettre en œuvre les capacités de stockage, de transformation et de chargement des données de nos pipelines.

• Améliorer continuellement la plateforme de données. Proposer, mettre en œuvre et gérer des services de traitement de données en fonction des besoins des parties prenantes (Chefs de produits, Marketing, Ventes, équipes d'ingénierie, ...)

• Établir des pipelines de bout en bout de premier ordre, y compris le nettoyage et la modélisation des données.

• Développer et déployer des connecteurs vers des sources de données d'intérêt.

• Maintenir une documentation permanente des flux de données entre les systèmes.

• Collaborer sur la gouvernance des données avec d'autres parties prenantes/domaines.

• Travailler avec la fonction de sécurité pour garantir que nous adhérons aux normes de sécurité attendues.

• Collaborer avec le gestionnaire d'incidents pour apporter votre expertise lorsque demandé et propre mise en œuvre des recommandations issues des post-mortems.

Expérience et qualifications

•
Vous possédez une solide expérience en génie logiciel, axée sur le développement de pipelines d’ingénierie de données et le stockage dans le cloud. Vous avez été exposé aux bases de l’architecture Big Data, au streaming, aux lots ETL, à l’administration du magasin de données,…

•
Vous vous voyez comme un développeur travaillant sur des données. Vous êtes motivé par les aspects techniques et fonctionnels des services.

•
Vous êtes un joueur d'équipe sympathique, enthousiaste et organisé. Vous partagez activement vos connaissances et donnez et recevez des commentaires pour améliorer l'équipe et vous-même.

•
Solide expérience dans la création de pipelines ETLT, ETL ou ELT de bout en bout avec des technologies par lots ou de streaming en Python.

•
Une expérience de travail avec Databricks en tant que plate-forme ou de création de pipelines de données avec PySpark est un plus.

•
Forte expérience avec la plateforme AWS incluant, mais sans s'y limiter, des services tels que : Glue, RedShift, CloudFormation, S3, CloudWatch, Lambdas, etc… ou équivalents

•
Bonne connaissance des concepts d’ingénierie des données (Data Lake, Data Warehouse, etc…)

•
Expérience avec les outils d'infrastructure en tant que code (CDK, CloudFormation, Terraform)

•
Vous parlez couramment l'anglais, tant à l'écrit qu'à l'oral

Pourquoi vous allez l'adorer ici :
• Notre culture et notre mission nous distinguent. Nous avons une culture de travail dynamique qui valorise le respect et la gentillesse – et embrasse le droit à l’échec (et à se relever !). Nous pensons que la meilleure idée gagne et que chacun a sa voix.

Nous valorisons les compétences relationnelles autant que les compétences techniques et nous nous efforçons de garder les choses amicales et décontractées tout en restant des leaders passionnés dans nos domaines. Nos plus de 550 SonarSourcers de 33 nationalités différentes peuvent s'identifier !

jobs.description:
Who is Sonar?

Sonar is driving the future of agent-centric software development. As the leader in AI code review and verification, we solve a critical problem: ensuring that software generated by AI-assisted developers or autonomous agents is reliable, secure, and maintainable.

Integrating seamlessly with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, and Devin, we help over 75% of the Fortune 100 build trusted, reliable, compliant software. Customers who use Sonar are 44% less likely to report an outage due to AI-generated code.

We believe code verification is the critical missing link in the Agent-Centric Development Cycle (AC/DC). Industry giants like Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company.count on us to provide independent, explainable, consistent review and governance of their AI-generated code via products like:

•
 SonarQube: The world’s leading AI code review and verification platform.

•
 SonarQube Foundation Agent: Currently topping the leaderboards for agentic software repair.

•
 SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Providing the enterprise-grade context and constraints agents need to be truly effective.

Our team operates across global hubs in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Geneva, London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Washington D.C. We move with a mindset we call CODE:

•
 Committed to our customers and community.

•
 Obsessed with quality.

•
 Deliberate in our decisions.

•
 Effective as one team.

With over $400M in revenue and profitable, fast-paced growth, we are building the backbone of the AI software revolution. If you’re hungry to have an impact, want to build at a fast pace, and ready to work at the forefront of AI, we want to hear from you.

Position description
 Our Information Security team's main goal is to build deep trust with our rapidly growing customer base. We do this by ensuring Sonar maintains a top-tier security posture to protect the people who rely on us. We are currently expanding this capability and hiring new members! In this role, you will work hand-in-hand with our CISO and across various teams to shape how we talk to our customers about security, privacy, and compliance and provide accurate and timely information to that audience. Your positive energy and contributions will have a direct impact on our business growth as you embrace Sonar's collective intelligence mindset.

What you will do

•
 Customer Interaction & Trust Center Enhancement: You will manage a straightforward process for answering security and technical questions from our customers and internal users. You will also enhance and maintain our Trust Center, making sure it proactively answers customer questions and serves as a go-to resource.

•
 Engineering & Security Collaboration: You will collaborate closely with our Engineering, Product, go-to-market and Information Security teams. Together, you will translate complex technical and architectural details into clear, accurate, and friendly responses for our customers.

•
 Contract Review & Technical Feedback: You will review customer contracts, MSAs, and DPAs. By partnering with our Legal and Sales teams, you will provide feedback, redlining, and negotiation support on security clauses to ensure everything aligns perfectly with our true capabilities and risk appetite.

•
 Trust System Management: You will keep our customer trust systems accurate and support a federated security approach across Sonar. You will also get to drive exciting improvements and add new capabilities to our tooling.

•
 AI Prompt Engineering: You will have the opportunity to develop and refine prompts and automated workflows using LLMs, helping us ensure our security information systems stay exceptionally valid and up to date.

Experience and qualifications

•
 Unwavering Customer Obsession: You truly view security as a way to enable people. You are passionate about building solutions that help teams innovate and move fast without ever compromising the safety of our organization or our users.

•
 Contract & Legal Acumen: You have solid experience reviewing, redlining, and providing feedback on security clauses and technical language in customer contracts. You are great at bridging the gap between Legal, Sales, Engineering and InfoSec.

•
 Technical Diplomacy & Engineering Collaboration: You are a fantastic communicator! You can partner deeply with Engineering to validate technical details and then turn around and explain those complex security requirements in clear, simple business terms for non-technical peers.

•
 Executive Presence: You are comfortable and experienced in working directly with senior leaders, especially a CISO. You know how to effectively communicate strategy, report on trust metrics, and give sound advice on risk.

•
 Extensive Multi-Domain InfoSec Expertise: You bring deep experience across several security domains, which might include GRC, Cloud Security, IAM, or Application Security. You are also very familiar with common compliance frameworks like SOC 2, ISO 27001, and GDPR that our customers care about.

•
 AI Proficiency: You have a proven ability to use AI tools and create complex prompts to solve tricky security problems and automate repetitive governance tasks.

•
 Autonomous Leadership & Organizational Acumen: You have the strong organizational skills needed to juggle multiple high-stakes projects, audit reviews, and contract negotiations all at once, requiring minimal supervision to achieve broad goals.

Additional comments
 This role is based in Geneva, Switzerland . We are unable to consider candidates unwilling to be in Geneva , but we are willing to relocate the right candidate.

In-office culture

We're intentional about this. We believe the best teams are built in the room together. Three anchor days — Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays — create the collaboration rhythm that makes a hub office worth having.

Candidates need to be genuinely based in the location the role is posted — if that's not where you are today, we're happy to support relocation for the right person.

We value diversity, equity, and inclusion

At Sonar, we believe that our diversity is our strength. We are a global company that values and respects different backgrounds, perspectives, and cultures. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome all qualified applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

If you need any accommodation, please reach out to us at hiring@sonarsource.com .

All offers of employment at Sonar are contingent upon the results of a comprehensive background check and reference verification conducted before the start date.

Applications that are submitted through agencies or third party recruiters will not be considered.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Chi è Sonar?

Sonar sta guidando il futuro dello sviluppo di software agent-centric. Come leader nella revisione e verifica del codice AI, risolviamo un problema critico: garantire che il software generato da sviluppatori o agenti autonomi AI-assisted sia affidabile, sicuro e manutenibile.

In linea con Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini e Devin, aiutiamo oltre il 75% del software di costruzione di Fortune 100 affidabile, affidabile e conforme. I clienti che utilizzano Sonar hanno il 44% in meno di probabilità di segnalare un'interruzione dovuta al codice generato da AI.

Crediamo che la verifica del codice sia il collegamento mancante critico nel ciclo di sviluppo dell'agente centrale (AC/DC). Colossi industriali come Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca e Ford Motor Company.count su di noi per fornire una revisione indipendente, spiegabile, coerente e governance del loro codice generato da AI attraverso prodotti come:

• SonarQube: Il mondo.s leader AI codice di revisione e piattaforma di verifica.

• SonarQube Foundation Agent: Attualmente topping le classifiche per la riparazione software agentic.

• SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: fornire il contesto di livello enterprise e i vincoli agli agenti devono essere veramente efficaci.

Il nostro team opera attraverso hub globali in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Ginevra, Londra, Singapore, Tokyo e Washington DC. Ci muoviamo con una mentalità che chiamiamo CODE:

• Commessi ai nostri clienti e comunità.

• Ossessionato dalla qualità.

• Deliberate nelle nostre decisioni.

• Efficace come una squadra.

Con oltre 400 milioni di dollari in entrate e una crescita redditizia e veloce, stiamo costruendo la spina dorsale della rivoluzione software AI. Se avete fame di avere un impatto, vogliono costruire ad un ritmo veloce, e pronti a lavorare in prima linea di AI, vogliamo sentire da voi.

Descrizione della posizione Il nostro team di sicurezza delle informazioni ha l'obiettivo principale di costruire una fiducia profonda con la nostra base clienti in rapida crescita. Lo facciamo assicurando che Sonar mantenga una posizione di sicurezza di alto livello per proteggere le persone che si affidano a noi. Attualmente stiamo espandendo questa capacità e assumendo nuovi membri! In questo ruolo, lavorerete fianco a fianco con il nostro CISO e tra vari team per definire come parliamo ai nostri clienti di sicurezza, privacy e conformità e fornire informazioni accurate e tempestive a quel pubblico.

La tua energia e i tuoi contributi positivi avranno un impatto diretto sulla nostra crescita aziendale, mentre tu avrai la mentalità dell'intelligenza collettiva di Sonar.

Cosa farai?

• Customer Interaction & Trust Center Enhancement: gestirai un processo semplice per rispondere alle domande di sicurezza e tecniche dei nostri clienti e degli utenti interni. Potrai anche migliorare e mantenere il nostro Trust Center, assicurandoti che risponda proattivamente alle domande dei clienti e serva da risorsa di base.

• Engineering & Security: collabora strettamente con i nostri team di Ingegneria, prodotto, mercato e sicurezza dell'informazione. Insieme, tradurrai dettagli tecnici e architettonici complessi in risposte chiare, accurate e amichevoli per i nostri clienti.

• Revisione dei contratti e feedback tecnico: Lei esaminerà i contratti dei clienti, gli MSA e gli DPA. Collaborando con i nostri team legali e di vendita, fornirà feedback, redlining e supporto negoziale sulle clausole di sicurezza per garantire che tutto si allinei perfettamente con le nostre reali capacità e l'appetito al rischio.

• Gestione del sistema di fiducia: Lei manterrà i nostri sistemi di fiducia dei clienti precisi e sosterrà un approccio di sicurezza federato in tutta Sonar. Lei inoltre otterrà per guidare miglioramenti entusiasmanti ed aggiungere nuove funzionalità al nostro strumento.

• Ingegneria Avanzata AI: Avrete la possibilità di sviluppare e perfezionare le istruzioni e i flussi di lavoro automatizzati utilizzando LLM, aiutandoci a garantire che i nostri sistemi di informazione di sicurezza rimangano eccezionalmente validi e aggiornati.

Esperienza e qualifiche

• Contratto & Accen: hai una solida esperienza nel campo della revisione, del redlining e del feedback sulle clausole di sicurezza e sul linguaggio tecnico nei contratti con i clienti. Sei bravo a colmare il divario tra Legale, Vendite, Ingegneria e InfoSec.

Who is Sonar?

Sonar is driving the future of agent-centric software development. As the leader in AI code review and verification, we solve a critical problem: ensuring that software generated by AI-assisted developers or autonomous agents is reliable, secure, and maintainable.

Integrating seamlessly with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, and Devin, we help over 75% of the Fortune 100 build trusted, reliable, compliant software. Customers who use Sonar are 44% less likely to report an outage due to AI-generated code.

We believe code verification is the critical missing link in the Agent-Centric Development Cycle (AC/DC). Industry giants like Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company.count on us to provide independent, explainable, consistent review and governance of their AI-generated code via products like:

•
SonarQube: The world’s leading AI code review and verification platform.

•
SonarQube Foundation Agent: Currently topping the leaderboards for agentic software repair.

•
SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Providing the enterprise-grade context and constraints agents need to be truly effective.

Our team operates across global hubs in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Geneva, London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Washington D.C. We move with a mindset we call CODE:

•
Committed to our customers and community.

•
Obsessed with quality.

•
Deliberate in our decisions.

•
Effective as one team.

With over $400M in revenue and profitable, fast-paced growth, we are building the backbone of the AI software revolution. If you’re hungry to have an impact, want to build at a fast pace, and ready to work at the forefront of AI, we want to hear from you.

Position description
Our Information Security team's main goal is to build deep trust with our rapidly growing customer base. We do this by ensuring Sonar maintains a top-tier security posture to protect the people who rely on us. We are currently expanding this capability and hiring new members! In this role, you will work hand-in-hand with our CISO and across various teams to shape how we talk to our customers about security, privacy, and compliance and provide accurate and timely information to that audience. Your positive energy and contributions will have a direct impact on our business growth as you embrace Sonar's collective intelligence mindset.

What you will do

•
Customer Interaction & Trust Center Enhancement: You will manage a straightforward process for answering security and technical questions from our customers and internal users. You will also enhance and maintain our Trust Center, making sure it proactively answers customer questions and serves as a go-to resource.

•
Engineering & Security Collaboration: You will collaborate closely with our Engineering, Product, go-to-market and Information Security teams. Together, you will translate complex technical and architectural details into clear, accurate, and friendly responses for our customers.

•
Contract Review & Technical Feedback: You will review customer contracts, MSAs, and DPAs. By partnering with our Legal and Sales teams, you will provide feedback, redlining, and negotiation support on security clauses to ensure everything aligns perfectly with our true capabilities and risk appetite.

•
Trust System Management: You will keep our customer trust systems accurate and support a federated security approach across Sonar. You will also get to drive exciting improvements and add new capabilities to our tooling.

•
AI Prompt Engineering: You will have the opportunity to develop and refine prompts and automated workflows using LLMs, helping us ensure our security information systems stay exceptionally valid and up to date.

Experience and qualifications

•
Unwavering Customer Obsession: You truly view security as a way to enable people. You are passionate about building solutions that help teams innovate and move fast without ever compromising the safety of our organization or our users.

•
Contract & Legal Acumen: You have solid experience reviewing, redlining, and providing feedback on security clauses and technical language in customer contracts. You are great at bridging the gap between Legal, Sales, Engineering and InfoSec.

•
Technical Diplomacy & Engineering Collaboration: You are a fantastic communicator! You can partner deeply with Engineering to validate technical details and then turn around and explain those complex security requirements in clear, simple business terms for non-technical peers.

•
Executive Presence: You are comfortable and experienced in working directly with senior leaders, especially a CISO. You know how to effectively communicate strategy, report on trust metrics, and give sound advice on risk.

•
Extensive Multi-Domain InfoSec Expertise: You bring deep experience across several security domains, which might include GRC, Cloud Security, IAM, or Application Security. You are also very familiar with common compliance frameworks like SOC 2, ISO 27001, and GDPR that our customers care about.

•
AI Proficiency: You have a proven ability to use AI tools and create complex prompts to solve tricky security problems and automate repetitive governance tasks.

•
Autonomous Leadership & Organizational Acumen: You have the strong organizational skills needed to juggle multiple high-stakes projects, audit reviews, and contract negotiations all at once, requiring minimal supervision to achieve broad goals.

Additional comments
This role is based in Geneva, Switzerland . We are unable to consider candidates unwilling to be in Geneva , but we are willing to relocate the right candidate.

In-office culture

We're intentional about this. We believe the best teams are built in the room together. Three anchor days — Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays — create the collaboration rhythm that makes a hub office worth having.

Candidates need to be genuinely based in the location the role is posted — if that's not where you are today, we're happy to support relocation for the right person.

We value diversity, equity, and inclusion

At Sonar, we believe that our diversity is our strength. We are a global company that values and respects different backgrounds, perspectives, and cultures. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome all qualified applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

If you need any accommodation, please reach out to us at hiring@sonarsource.com .

All offers of employment at Sonar are contingent upon the results of a comprehensive background check and reference verification conducted before the start date.

Applications that are submitted through agencies or third party recruiters will not be considered.
