descriptionByLocale.en:
Who is Sonar?

Sonar is driving the future of agent-centric software development. As the leader in AI code verification and governance, we solve a critical problem: ensuring that software generated by AI-assisted developers or autonomous agents is reliable, secure, and maintainable.

Integrating seamlessly with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, and Devin, we help over 75% of the Fortune 100 build trusted, reliable, compliant software. Customers who use Sonar are 44% less likely to report an outage due to AI-generated code.

We believe code verification is the critical missing link in the Agent-Centric Development Cycle (AC/DC). Industry giants like Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company count on us to provide independent, explainable, consistent review and governance of their AI-generated code via products like:

• SonarQube: The world’s leading AI code review and verification platform.

• SonarQube Foundation Agent: Currently topping the leaderboards for agentic software repair.

• SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Providing the enterprise-grade context and constraints agents need to be truly effective.

Our team operates across global hubs in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Geneva, London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Washington D.C. We move with a mindset we call CODE:

• Committed to our customers and community.

• Obsessed with quality.

• Deliberate in our decisions.

• Effective as one team.

With over $400M in revenue and profitable, fast-paced growth, we are building the backbone of the AI software revolution. If you’re hungry to have an impact, want to build at a fast pace, and ready to work at the forefront of AI, we want to hear from you.

The Sonar Solutions Engineering team is dedicated to helping our prospective customers achieve technical success with our products. This is your chance to join a growing team as we scale up our efforts to have maximum impact on our targeted customer base.

As a Solutions Engineer at Sonar, you’ll play a central role in providing deep technical expertise to our prospects and supporting them in evaluating our solution. The SE team works as part of the Sales process and also engages with Marketing, Product Management, and Development teams to provide feedback on our products' evolution and messaging.

What you will do daily

• Help prospective customers understand how our AC/DC approach fits within their software development life cycle

• Drive technical aspects of pre-sales business opportunities by doing technical presentations and demonstrations and supporting product evaluations

• Advise customers on the best alignment of the Sonar solution with their favored deployment strategy

• Troubleshoot and resolve technical problems encountered by prospective customers evaluating our products

• Go beyond the sale to ensure successful product adoption and growth following purchase, working with our Customer Success and Support teams

• Help existing customers understand the additional capabilities of advanced product editions

• Provide technical enablement to channel partners to raise their level of service

Experience and qualifications

• Some practical experience in software development or DevOps engineering highly desirable

• Familiarity of both local and cloud-based software deployment platforms and technologies, including Linux, Windows, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, Azure

• Passion for technology and successful customer outcomes

• Ability to dive into complex technical problems, perform troubleshooting, develop solutions, and articulate them in verbal and written form

• Proven ability to work in a team, receiving and giving feedback as well as sharing knowledge

• A can-do attitude: challenging the status quo, leading and contributing to key improvements and innovations

• Excellent presentation skills

• Excellent English, verbal/written communication skills

• German language is desirable but not a hard requirement

In-office culture

We're intentional about this. We believe the best teams are built in the room together. Three anchor days — Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays — create the collaboration rhythm that makes a hub office worth having.

Candidates need to be genuinely based in the location the role is posted — if that's not where you are today, we're happy to support relocation for the right person.

We value diversity, equity, and inclusion

At Sonar, we believe that our diversity is our strength. We are a global company that values and respects different backgrounds, perspectives, and cultures. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome all qualified applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

If you need any accommodation, please reach out to us at hiring@sonarsource.com .

All offers of employment at Sonar are contingent upon the results of a comprehensive background check and reference verification conducted before the start date.

Applications that are submitted through agencies or third party recruiters will not be considered.

Who is Sonar?

Sonar is driving the future of agent-centric software development. As the leader in AI code verification and governance, we solve a critical problem: ensuring that software generated by AI-assisted developers or autonomous agents is reliable, secure, and maintainable.

• SonarQube: The world’s leading AI code review and verification platform.

• SonarQube Foundation Agent: Currently topping the leaderboards for agentic software repair.

• SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Providing the enterprise-grade context and constraints agents need to be truly effective.

Our team operates across global hubs in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Geneva, London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Washington D.C. We move with a mindset we call CODE:

• Obsessed with quality.

• Deliberate in our decisions.

• Effective as one team.

With over $400M in revenue and profitable, fast-paced growth, we are building the backbone of the AI software revolution. If you’re hungry to have an impact, want to build at a fast pace, and ready to work at the forefront of AI, we want to hear from you.

Sonar is looking for a results-driven Sales Manager to lead, coach, and grow a team of Account Executives driving new business and expansion revenue for our AI code verification and governance platform. Lead, coach, and motivate a team of Account Executives to consistently meet or exceed quota

Recruit, onboard, and train new sales talent, building a strong bench for future growth

Conduct regular 1:1s, deal reviews, and call/demo coaching sessions to develop rep skills

Partner with Sales Operations and Marketing to optimize territory planning, lead flow, and go-to-market execution

Analyze team performance metrics (win rate, average deal size, sales cycle length, activity levels) and act on insights

Set clear goals and KPIs for each team member and hold the team accountable to them

Champion Sonar's CODE values and foster a positive, high-performance team culture

•
Escalate and help resolve customer or deal issues as needed

•
Report on team performance and forecasts to senior sales leadership

•
Have 10+ years of selling experience, including 5+ years of sales leadership experience

•
Have a proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets, both individually and as a team leader

•
Bring strong coaching and people-management skills, with experience developing reps at different skill levels

•
Communicate, negotiate, and present with excellence

•
Have experience with sales toolkits (e.g., Salesforce, Clari, Tableau) and sales forecasting/pipeline management

•
Take a data-driven approach to decision-making and performance management, leveraging AI-powered insights to identify trends and optimize team outcomes.

Hold a Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience

•
Must have experience selling in a B2B SaaS or technology environment

•

Demonstrate resilience, adaptability, and the capacity to thrive in fast-paced, dynamic settings

descriptionByLocale.en:
Who is Sonar?

Sonar is driving the future of agent-centric software development. As the leader in AI code verification and governance, we solve a critical problem: ensuring that software generated by AI-assisted developers or autonomous agents is reliable, secure, and maintainable.

Integrating seamlessly with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, and Devin, we help over 75% of the Fortune 100 build trusted, reliable, compliant software. Customers who use Sonar are 44% less likely to report an outage due to AI-generated code.

We believe code verification is the critical missing link in the Agent-Centric Development Cycle (AC/DC). Industry giants like Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company count on us to provide independent, explainable, consistent review and governance of their AI-generated code via products like:

• SonarQube: The world’s leading AI code review and verification platform.

• SonarQube Foundation Agent: Currently topping the leaderboards for agentic software repair.

• SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Providing the enterprise-grade context and constraints agents need to be truly effective.

Our team operates across global hubs in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Geneva, London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Washington D.C. We move with a mindset we call CODE:

• Committed to our customers and community.

• Obsessed with quality.

• Deliberate in our decisions.

• Effective as one team.

With over $400M in revenue and profitable, fast-paced growth, we are building the backbone of the AI software revolution. If you’re hungry to have an impact, want to build at a fast pace, and ready to work at the forefront of AI, we want to hear from you.

Position description

Sonar is looking for a customer-centric Platform Product Manager to drive the foundational capabilities that make our products enterprise-ready, trusted by the world’s largest organizations and truly loved by developers around the world. You will be part of the Product Management team that drives the vision and roadmaps for our core platform infrastructure. We are currently looking for Product Managers with a deep technical background in enterprise SaaS capabilities.

This role sits at the intersection of core infrastructure and customer needs. As a Product Manager, you will shape our platform's core pillars to deliver an enterprise-grade, seamless experience our customers can trust. To achieve this perfect match, we need a passionate Product Manager who will research, clarify, prioritize the needs of external IT administrators, DevOps, and security teams, and translate those needs across our product line. You will become an expert user of our core platform, from very high-level user settings down to the technical aspects of our infrastructure.

You will join the Product Management team, which is composed of other passionate Product Managers eager to collaborate with you. You will also work closely with engaged Engineering teams to ensure that the proposed solutions meet the expected outcome and that we collectively deliver the best products to help teams adopt our software at scale to write better and more secure code.

By joining us, you will bring your deep knowledge of enterprise-grade platforms (such as data sovereignty, encryption, or global performance scaling) and your experience as a Product Manager to help us reach the next level and provide an awesome user experience to millions of developers.

What you will do

• Contribute to the different areas of the Platform vision and communicate about them, internally and externally.

•
Research, clarify, and prioritize opportunities to build and maintain an effective roadmap, focused on customer trust and platform readiness.

•
Interact directly with our users and customers on our product forum to support them, integrate their feedback, and identify opportunities.

•
Develop a deep understanding of customer-facing platform needs (e.g., data residency, advanced access controls, and application performance) and how we can enable organizations to scale seamlessly..

•
Work closely with other product managers to design cross-product foundational features.

•
Align with the engineering and UX teams on the foundational system and usability problems to solve and support them during the end-to-end development stage of the solutions.

•
Sync with the engineering teams to ensure that there is a good balance between innovation, consolidation, and stability.

•
Attend conferences and give talks about platform scale if you like.

•
Help the Product Management team grow in its organization, tools, and processes.

Experience and qualifications

• Passionate about enterprise software operability and the practices that lead to secure and highly available applications.

•
Deep understanding of core platform pillars (e.g., data isolation, customer-managed encryption, design systems, API best-practices, or global performance optimization).

•
Technical comprehension of self-hosted deployment, cloud-native environments, multi-region deployments, and data residency frameworks.

•
Experience with the latest developments in AI assisted coding and how they impact platform scale.

•
Experience in software product management, preferably managing platform products in an agile context.

•
Highly autonomous and pragmatic, with an obsession for solving external customer problems.

•
Open-minded and very positive can-do attitude.

•
Comfortable in dealing with change, complexity, and uncertainty.

•
Self-confident enough to challenge the status quo as well as to receive feedback.

•
Leadership: you take initiative and demonstrate your ability to lead a subject from beginning to end.

In-office culture

We're intentional about this. We believe the best teams are built in the room together. Three anchor days — Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays — create the collaboration rhythm that makes a hub office worth having.

Candidates need to be genuinely based in the location the role is posted — if that's not where you are today, we're happy to support relocation for the right person.

We value diversity, equity, and inclusion

At Sonar, we believe that our diversity is our strength. We are a global company that values and respects different backgrounds, perspectives, and cultures. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome all qualified applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

If you need any accommodation, please reach out to us at hiring@sonarsource.com .

All offers of employment at Sonar are contingent upon the results of a comprehensive background check and reference verification conducted before the start date.

Applications that are submitted through agencies or third party recruiters will not be considered.

jobs.description:
Who is Sonar?

Sonar is driving the future of agent-centric software development. As the leader in AI code verification and governance, we solve a critical problem: ensuring that software generated by AI-assisted developers or autonomous agents is reliable, secure, and maintainable.

Integrating seamlessly with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, and Devin, we help over 75% of the Fortune 100 build trusted, reliable, compliant software. Customers who use Sonar are 44% less likely to report an outage due to AI-generated code.

We believe code verification is the critical missing link in the Agent-Centric Development Cycle (AC/DC). Industry giants like Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company count on us to provide independent, explainable, consistent review and governance of their AI-generated code via products like:

• SonarQube: The world’s leading AI code review and verification platform.

• SonarQube Foundation Agent: Currently topping the leaderboards for agentic software repair.

• SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Providing the enterprise-grade context and constraints agents need to be truly effective.

Our team operates across global hubs in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Geneva, London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Washington D.C. We move with a mindset we call CODE:

• Committed to our customers and community.

• Obsessed with quality.

• Deliberate in our decisions.

• Effective as one team.

With over $400M in revenue and profitable, fast-paced growth, we are building the backbone of the AI software revolution. If you’re hungry to have an impact, want to build at a fast pace, and ready to work at the forefront of AI, we want to hear from you.

The Impact You Will Have:

The Partner Manager wins, maintains, and expands relationships with assigned channel partners. Assigned to channel partners based on geography, channel, or market, the Partner Manager is responsible for achieving qualified pipeline development, profitability, and partner recruitment objectives. The Partner Manager represents the entire range of Sonar’s products and services to assigned partners though may focus on a specific solution or product set if focused in a partner vertical market. The Partner Manager reports to the Vice President of EMEA & APJ Channels. The success of a Sonar Partner is the success of a Partner Manager at Sonar! We believe the following will support a robust Partner Ecosystem and contribute to the success of Sonar’s strategic partners: We are looking for passionate and energetic team members to join us in building a strong and healthy partner ecosystem.

What You Will Do Daily:

• Discover, evaluate, and develop potential partners with business models and technology stacks that complement Sonar’s offerings

• Potential partners include Global and Regional Consulting Partners, System Integrators, Software Resellers, Technology Alliance and Distributors and where applicable Hyperscalers.

• Develop partner territory plan for a regional and execute the business plan to deliver outcomes measures in new bookings $, Renewal $ and % and new logos

• Establishes productive, professional, and strong relationships with key personnel in assigned partner accounts and territoriesInitiates the involvement of company personnel, including support, service, sales, marketing, and management resources that would contribute to the success of the partner ecosystem

• Engaged in meaningful business and account QBR’s to support partners in meeting assigned targets for profitable sales volume and strategic objectives in assigned partner accounts

• Build momentum and executable next steps in the joint partner planning process that develops mutual performance objectives, financial targets, and critical milestones associated with a productive partner relationship

• Proactively assesses, clarifies, and validates partner needs on an ongoing basis

• Proactive management with Sonar’s channel policies, stringent expectations management of partners to minimize channel conflict

• Ensures partners receive and complete the required enablement program Ensures partner and Sonar’s continuous business and technology aligns and complies.

The Experience You Will Need:

• 7+ years of proven experience in channel and partner management in a technology software B2B, ideally in a SaaS or subscription model, Dev Tools experience would be a plus

• Proven track record in building, maintaining, and expanding high-performance partners in the EMEA region

• Self-starter, can-do attitude and willingness to roll up sleeves and never afraid to do the impossible

• Strong communication and listening skills, able to influence at all levels

• Strong ability to work effectively as part of a team. Be a bar raiser in the company values and culture

• Curious, willing to unlearn to learn. Confident and a great communicator

• MUST HAVE - Relationships and experience working with key VAR's including Softcat, Bytes, Computercentre, and Insight

• NICE TO HAVE - Working with Crayon SoftwareOne, bespoke DevOps VAR's

We value diversity, equity, and inclusion

At Sonar, we believe that our diversity is our strength. We are a global company that values and respects different backgrounds, perspectives, and cultures. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome all qualified applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

If you need any accommodation, please reach out to us at hiring@sonarsource.com .

All offers of employment at Sonar are contingent upon the results of a comprehensive background check and reference verification conducted before the start date.

Applications that are submitted through agencies or third party recruiters will not be considered.

In-office culture

We're intentional about this. We believe the best teams are built in the room together. Three anchor days — Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays — create the collaboration rhythm that makes a hub office worth having.

Candidates need to be genuinely based in the location the role is posted — if that's not where you are today, we're happy to support relocation for the right person.

jobs.title: Marketing AI Engineer
jobs.description:
Who is Sonar?

Sonar is driving the future of agent-centric software development. As the leader in AI code review and verification, we solve a critical problem: ensuring that software generated by AI-assisted developers or autonomous agents is reliable, secure, and maintainable.

Integrating seamlessly with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, and Devin, we help over 75% of the Fortune 100 build trusted, reliable, compliant software. Customers who use Sonar are 44% less likely to report an outage due to AI-generated code.

We believe code verification is the critical missing link in the Agent-Centric Development Cycle (AC/DC). Industry giants like Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company count on us to provide independent, explainable, consistent review and governance of their AI-generated code via products like:

•
 SonarQube: The world’s leading AI code review and verification platform.

•
 SonarQube Foundation Agent: Currently topping the leaderboards for agentic software repair.

•
 SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Providing the enterprise-grade context and constraints agents need to be truly effective.

Our team operates across global hubs in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Geneva, London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Washington D.C. We move with a mindset we call CODE:

•
 Committed to our customers and community.

•
 Obsessed with quality.

•
 Deliberate in our decisions.

•
 Effective as one team.

With over $400M in revenue and profitable, fast-paced growth, we are building the backbone of the AI software revolution. If you’re hungry to have an impact, want to build at a fast pace, and ready to work at the forefront of AI, we want to hear from you.

Position description

As Sonar’s Marketing AI Engineer, you design, build, and maintain the AI agents and automated workflows that multiply the impact of the marketing function. You spend time with marketing stakeholders to understand their work in depth, identify where automation creates real leverage, and then build and iterate until it works well. You produce clear reporting on efficiency and impact, keeping marketing leadership informed on what the automations are actually delivering.

The best person for this role might be a marketing ops veteran who has taught themselves to build with AI, or an automation engineer who has gone deep on how marketing actually works. Either way, what matters is the combination: you understand marketing processes from the inside, and you can build reliable automations that make those processes faster, smarter, and more scalable.

What you will do

•
 Map and prioritize automation opportunities: Work closely with marketing teams to develop a deep understanding of their day-to-day processes — identifying where AI agents and automated workflows can eliminate manual work, reduce errors, or unlock capabilities that weren’t previously possible.

•
 Design and build AI agents: Develop AI agents and automated workflows that streamline marketing processes — from content production and campaign operations to reporting, lead routing, and personalization at scale.

•
 Deploy and maintain automations: Own the full lifecycle of deployed agents — from initial release through ongoing monitoring, debugging, and iteration — ensuring reliability and performance as usage grows.

•
 Produce efficiency and impact reporting: Track and report on workflow automation metrics — time saved, error rates, throughput, and business impact — delivering regular dashboards and summaries to marketing leadership.

•
 Stay current on AI tooling: Continuously evaluate new AI models, agent frameworks, and automation platforms — bringing a clear point of view on what Sonar marketing should adopt, experiment with, or build on next.

•
 Partner with Marketing Tooling & AI Operations: Collaborate closely with the Marketing Tooling & AI Operations Manager to understand the existing tool stack, ensure automations integrate reliably with it, and drive adoption of new AI-powered capabilities.

•
 Ensure data quality and governance: Design automations that handle marketing data responsibly — with attention to data quality, privacy, and auditability across all deployed workflows.

•
 Document and enable: Produce clear documentation for all deployed agents and workflows, and run internal enablement sessions to help the marketing team understand and effectively use what you have built.

Experience and qualifications

•
 Have 3+ years of experience in marketing operations, automation engineering, or a closely related role — with a track record of building workflows or automations that measurably improved team efficiency.

•
 Have deep, hands-on knowledge of marketing processes and tools — including CRM (Salesforce), marketing automation, campaign ops, analytics, and content workflows. A marketing ops practitioner who has grown into building automations is a strong fit.

•
 Be experienced with no-code/low-code automation platforms (e.g., Make, Zapier, n8n) and comfortable extending them with scripting when needed (Python and/or JavaScript).

•
 Have working familiarity with AI agent frameworks (e.g., LangChain, Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Assistants) or a demonstrated ability and appetite to ramp quickly.

•
 Be experienced integrating with third-party APIs and working with marketing data structures (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot, GA, Marketo).

•
 Have strong analytical skills and experience building performance dashboards and reporting for deployed automations.

•
 Be a clear communicator who can explain what an automation does — and why it matters — to non-technical stakeholders, and translate their requirements into precise technical specifications.

•
 Bring intellectual curiosity and a bias to build — you stay current on the fast-moving AI landscape and bring that knowledge into your everyday work.

•
 Hold a Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Computer Science, or a related field.

In-office culture

We’re intentional about this. We believe the best teams are built in the room together. Three anchor days — Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays — create the collaboration rhythm that makes a hub office worth having.

Candidates need to be genuinely based in the location the role is posted — if that’s not where you are today, we’re happy to support relocation for the right person.

We value diversity, equity, and inclusion

At Sonar, we believe that our diversity is our strength. We are a global company that values and respects different backgrounds, perspectives, and cultures. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome all qualified applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

If you need any accommodation, please reach out to us at hiring@sonarsource.com.

All offers of employment at Sonar are contingent upon the results of a comprehensive background check and reference verification conducted before the start date.

Applications that are submitted through agencies or third party recruiters will not be considered.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Chi è Sonar?

Sonar sta guidando il futuro dello sviluppo software agente-centrico. Come leader nella revisione e nella verifica del codice AI, risolviamo un problema critico: garantire che il software generato da sviluppatori assistiti da AI o agenti autonomi sia affidabile, sicuro e manutenbile.

Integrando senza soluzione di continuità con Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini e Devin, aiutiamo oltre il 75% del software Fortune 100 costruire affidabile, affidabile, conforme. I clienti che utilizzano Sonar sono il 44% meno probabilità di segnalare un outage a causa del codice generato dall'IA.

Crediamo che la verifica del codice sia il collegamento mancante fondamentale nel Ciclo di Sviluppo Agent-Centric (AC/DC). I giganti del settore come Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca e Ford Motor Company contano su di noi per fornire una revisione indipendente, spiegabile, coerente e la governance del loro codice generato dall'IA attraverso prodotti come:

•
SonarQube: la piattaforma leader mondiale per la revisione e la verifica del codice AI.

•
SonarQube Foundation Agent: Attualmente il lancio delle classifiche per la riparazione di software agentic.

•
SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Fornire il contesto di livello enterprise e gli agenti vincoli devono essere veramente efficaci.

Il nostro team opera in tutto il mondo a Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Ginevra, Londra, Singapore, Tokyo e Washington D.C. Ci muoviamo con una mentalità che chiamiamo CODE:

•
Impegnati ai nostri clienti e comunità.

•
Obsessed con qualità.

•
Deliberate nelle nostre decisioni.

•
Efficace come una squadra.

Con oltre 400 milioni di dollari di ricavi e crescita redditizia e rapida, stiamo costruendo la spina dorsale della rivoluzione software AI. Se hai fame di avere un impatto, vuoi costruire ad un ritmo veloce, e pronto a lavorare in prima linea di AI, vogliamo sentire da te.

Descrizione della posizione

Come Ingegnere AI Marketing di Sonar, progetta, costruisce e mantiene gli agenti AI e flussi di lavoro automatizzati che moltiplicano l'impatto della funzione di marketing. Si passa del tempo con le parti interessate di marketing per capire il loro lavoro in profondità, identificare dove l'automazione crea leva reale, e poi costruire e iterare fino a quando non funziona bene. Produci una chiara segnalazione su efficienza e impatto, mantenendo la leadership di marketing informata su ciò che le automazioni stanno effettivamente fornendo.

La persona migliore per questo ruolo potrebbe essere un veterano delle operazioni di marketing che si è insegnato a costruire con l'IA, o un ingegnere di automazione che è andato a fondo su come il marketing funziona realmente. In entrambi i casi, ciò che conta è la combinazione: si comprendono i processi di marketing dall'interno, e si possono costruire automazioni affidabili che rendono quei processi più veloci, più intelligenti e più scalabili.

Cosa farai

•
Mappa e priorità opportunità di automazione: lavorare a stretto contatto con i team di marketing per sviluppare una profonda comprensione dei loro processi quotidiani - identificare dove agenti di AI e flussi di lavoro automatizzati possono eliminare il lavoro manuale, ridurre gli errori, o sbloccare le capacità che non erano precedentemente possibili.

•
Progettazione e costruzione di agenti AI: Sviluppare agenti AI e flussi di lavoro automatizzati che razionalizzano i processi di marketing - dalle operazioni di produzione di contenuti e campagna a reporting, routing di piombo e personalizzazione in scala.

•
Distribuire e mantenere le automazioni: proprio il ciclo di vita completo di agenti schierati — dal rilascio iniziale attraverso il monitoraggio continuo, il debug e l'iterazione — garantire affidabilità e prestazioni come l'utilizzo cresce.

•
Produrre l'efficienza e la segnalazione dell'impatto: monitorare e segnalare le metriche di automazione del flusso di lavoro — risparmio di tempo, tassi di errore, throughput e impatto aziendale — fornire dashboard regolari e riassunti alla leadership di marketing.

•
Mantenere corrente sull'attrezzo AI: Valutare costantemente nuovi modelli AI, quadri di agente e piattaforme di automazione — portando un punto di vista chiaro su ciò che il marketing Sonar dovrebbe adottare, sperimentare, o costruire su successivo.

•
Partner con Marketing Tooling & AI Operations: Collaborare a stretto contatto con il Marketing Tooling & AI Operations Manager per comprendere lo stack degli strumenti esistenti, garantire che le automazioni si integrano in modo affidabile con esso, e guidare l'adozione di nuove funzionalità AI-powered.

•
Garantire qualità e governance dei dati: Automazioni di progettazione che gestiscono i dati di marketing in modo responsabile, con attenzione alla qualità dei dati, alla privacy e alla verificabilità in tutti i flussi di lavoro distribuiti.

•
Documento e abilita: Produrre una documentazione chiara per tutti gli agenti e i flussi di lavoro schierati e eseguire sessioni di abilitazione interne per aiutare il team di marketing a capire ed utilizzare efficacemente ciò che hai costruito.

Esperienza e qualifiche

•
Avere 3+ anni di esperienza nelle operazioni di marketing, ingegneria dell'automazione, o un ruolo strettamente correlato — con un track record di workflow di costruzione o di automazione che migliorano measurly l'efficienza del team.

•
Avere una conoscenza approfondita e pratica dei processi e degli strumenti di marketing, tra cui CRM (Salesforce), automazione di marketing, ops di campagna, analisi e flussi di lavoro di contenuto. Un professionista di marketing ops che è cresciuto in automazione di costruzione è una forma forte.

•
Essere esperti con piattaforme di automazione senza codice/basso codice (ad esempio, Make, Zapier, n8n) e confortevole estendendoli con script quando necessario (Python e/o JavaScript).

•
Avere familiarità con i framework dell'agente AI (ad esempio, LangChain, Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Assistants) o una capacità dimostrata e l'appetito di rampa rapidamente.

•
Essere sperimentato integrando con API di terze parti e lavorando con le strutture di dati di marketing (ad esempio, Salesforce, HubSpot, GA, Marketo).

•
Avere forti competenze analitiche e esperienza costruire dashboard di performance e reporting per l'automazione schierata.

•
Essere un comunicatore chiaro che può spiegare ciò che fa un'automazione - e perché conta - agli stakeholder non tecnici, e tradurre i loro requisiti in specifiche tecniche precise.

•
Portare curiosità intellettuale e un pregiudizio da costruire — si rimane corrente sul paesaggio AI veloce-moving e portare questa conoscenza nel vostro lavoro quotidiano.

•
Tenere una laurea in Marketing, Business, Informatica, o un campo correlato.

Cultura in ufficio

Siamo intenzionali su questo. Crediamo che le migliori squadre siano costruite nella stanza insieme. Tre giorni di ancora — lunedì, martedì e giovedì — creano il ritmo di collaborazione che rende un hub office degno di avere.

I candidati devono essere autenticamente basati nel luogo in cui il ruolo è pubblicato — se non è lì che sei oggi, siamo lieti di sostenere il trasferimento per la persona giusta.

Valoriamo la diversità, l'equità e l'inclusione

A Sonar, crediamo che la nostra diversità sia la nostra forza. Siamo una società globale che valorizza e rispetta diversi sfondi, prospettive e culture. Ci impegniamo a promuovere un ambiente di lavoro diversificato e inclusivo in cui tutti si sentono valorizzati e potenziati per contribuire al meglio. Siamo orgogliosi di essere un datore di lavoro pari opportunità e di accogliere tutti i candidati qualificati, indipendentemente da razza, colore, religione, sesso, identità di genere o espressione, orientamento sessuale, origine nazionale, genetica, disabilità, età, o stato veterano.

Se avete bisogno di un alloggio, contattateci all'indirizzo hiring@sonarsource.com.

Tutte le offerte di lavoro a Sonar sono contingenti sui risultati di un controllo completo di sfondo e verifica di riferimento effettuato prima della data di inizio.

Le domande che vengono presentate tramite agenzie o reclutatori di terze parti non saranno considerate.

•
Bring intellectual curiosity and a bias to build — you stay current on the fast-moving AI landscape and bring that knowledge into your everyday work.

•
Hold a Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Computer Science, or a related field.

In-office culture

We’re intentional about this. We believe the best teams are built in the room together. Three anchor days — Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays — create the collaboration rhythm that makes a hub office worth having.

Candidates need to be genuinely based in the location the role is posted — if that’s not where you are today, we’re happy to support relocation for the right person.

We value diversity, equity, and inclusion

At Sonar, we believe that our diversity is our strength. We are a global company that values and respects different backgrounds, perspectives, and cultures. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome all qualified applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Wer ist Sonar?

Sonar treibt die Zukunft der agentenzentrierten Softwareentwicklung voran. Als führendes Unternehmen im Bereich der Überprüfung und Verifizierung von KI-Codes lösen wir ein entscheidendes Problem: sicherzustellen, dass Software, die von KI-unterstützten Entwicklern oder autonomen Agenten erstellt wird, zuverlässig, sicher und wartbar ist.

Durch die nahtlose Integration mit Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini und Devin helfen wir über 75% der Fortune 100 dabei, vertrauenswürdige, zuverlässige und konforme Software zu erstellen. Kunden, die Sonar verwenden, haben eine um 44% geringere Wahrscheinlichkeit, einen Ausfall aufgrund von AI-generiertem Code zu melden.

Wir glauben, dass die Codeverifizierung das kritische fehlende Glied im Agent-Centric Development Cycle (AC/DC) ist. Branchenriesen wie Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca und Ford Motor Company zählen darauf, dass wir eine unabhängige, erklärbare, konsistente Überprüfung und Governance ihres KI-generierten Codes über Produkte wie:

•
SonarQube: Die weltweit führende Plattform für die Überprüfung und Verifizierung von KI-Codes.

•
SonarQube Foundation Agent: Derzeit Spitzenreiter bei der Reparatur von Agentic-Software.

•
SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Die Bereitstellung von Kontexten und Einschränkungen für Unternehmen muss wirklich effektiv sein.

Unser Team ist in globalen Hubs in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Genf, London, Singapur, Tokio und Washington D.C. tätig. Wir bewegen uns mit einer Denkweise, die wir CODE nennen:

•
Unseren Kunden und der Community verpflichtet.

•
Besessen von Qualität.

•
Absichtlich in unseren Entscheidungen.

•
Effektiv als ein Team.

Mit über 400 Millionen US-Dollar Umsatz und profitablem, schnellem Wachstum bauen wir das Rückgrat der KI-Software-Revolution auf. Wenn Sie hungrig sind, etwas zu bewirken, schnell bauen und bereit sind, an der Spitze der KI zu arbeiten, möchten wir von Ihnen hören.

Positionsbeschreibung

Als Marketing AI Engineer von Sonar entwerfen, bauen und warten Sie die KI-Agenten und automatisierten Workflows, die die Auswirkungen der Marketingfunktion vervielfachen. Sie verbringen Zeit mit Marketing-Stakeholdern, um ihre Arbeit eingehend zu verstehen, herauszufinden, wo die Automatisierung echte Hebelwirkung schafft, und dann zu bauen und zu iterieren, bis es gut funktioniert. Sie erstellen eine klare Berichterstattung über Effizienz und Auswirkungen und halten die Marketingleitung darüber informiert, was die Automatisierungen tatsächlich liefern.

Die beste Person für diese Rolle könnte ein Marketing-Ops-Veteran sein, der sich selbst beigebracht hat, mit KI zu bauen, oder ein Automatisierungsingenieur, der sich eingehend damit beschäftigt hat, wie Marketing tatsächlich funktioniert. In jedem Fall kommt es auf die Kombination an: Sie verstehen Marketingprozesse von innen und können zuverlässige Automatisierungen erstellen, die diese Prozesse schneller, intelligenter und skalierbarer machen.

Was du tun wirst

•
Planen und priorisieren Sie Automatisierungsmöglichkeiten: Arbeiten Sie eng mit Marketingteams zusammen, um ein tiefes Verständnis ihrer täglichen Prozesse zu entwickeln – und ermitteln Sie, wo KI-Agenten und automatisierte Workflows manuelle Arbeit eliminieren, Fehler reduzieren oder Funktionen freischalten können, die zuvor nicht möglich waren.

•
Entwerfen und Erstellen von KI-Agenten: Entwickeln Sie KI-Agenten und automatisierte Workflows, die Marketingprozesse optimieren - von der Content-Produktion und Kampagnenoperationen bis hin zu Reporting, Lead-Routing und Personalisierung in großem Maßstab.

•
Bereitstellung und Wartung von Automatisierungen: Besitzen Sie den gesamten Lebenszyklus der bereitgestellten Agenten - von der ersten Veröffentlichung über die laufende Überwachung, das Debuggen und die Iteration - und gewährleisten Sie Zuverlässigkeit und Leistung bei wachsender Nutzung.

•
Erstellen von Effizienz- und Impact-Reporting: Verfolgen und Berichten über Workflow-Automatisierungsmetriken - Zeiteinsparungen, Fehlerquoten, Durchsatz und Geschäftsauswirkungen - und liefern regelmäßige Dashboards und Zusammenfassungen an die Marketingleitung.

•
Bleiben Sie auf dem Laufenden über KI-Tools: Evaluieren Sie kontinuierlich neue KI-Modelle, Agenten-Frameworks und Automatisierungsplattformen und bringen Sie einen klaren Standpunkt dazu, was Sonar-Marketing als nächstes übernehmen, experimentieren oder darauf aufbauen sollte.

•
Partnerschaft mit Marketing Tooling & AI Operations: Arbeiten Sie eng mit dem Marketing Tooling & AI Operations Manager zusammen, um den vorhandenen Werkzeugstapel zu verstehen, sicherzustellen, dass Automatisierungen zuverlässig in ihn integriert werden und die Einführung neuer KI-basierter Funktionen vorantreiben.

•
Datenqualität und Governance sicherstellen: Entwerfen Sie Automatisierungen, die verantwortungsvoll mit Marketingdaten umgehen – mit Blick auf Datenqualität, Datenschutz und Auditierbarkeit in allen bereitgestellten Workflows.

•
Dokumentieren und aktivieren: Erstellen Sie eine übersichtliche Dokumentation für alle bereitgestellten Agenten und Workflows und führen Sie interne Aktivierungssitzungen durch, um dem Marketingteam zu helfen, das von Ihnen Erstellte zu verstehen und effektiv zu nutzen.

Erfahrung und Qualifikationen

•
Haben Sie mehr als 3 Jahre Erfahrung in Marketing-Operationen, Automatisierungstechnik oder einer eng verwandten Rolle - mit einer Erfolgsbilanz bei der Erstellung von Workflows oder Automatisierungen, die die Teameffizienz messbar verbessert haben.

•
Haben Sie ein tiefes, praktisches Wissen über Marketingprozesse und Tools - einschließlich CRM (Salesforce), Marketing-Automatisierung, Kampagnen-Ops, Analysen und Content-Workflows. Ein Marketing-Ops-Praktiker, der zu Gebäudeautomationen gewachsen ist, passt gut zusammen.

•
Erfahren Sie mit No-Code / Low-Code-Automatisierungsplattformen (z. B. Make, Zapier, n8n) und erweitern Sie diese bei Bedarf bequem mit Skripting (Python und / oder JavaScript).

•
Vertrautheit mit KI-Agent-Frameworks (z. B. LangChain, Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Assistants) oder eine nachgewiesene Fähigkeit und Appetit, schnell zu rasen.

•
Erfahren Sie die Integration in APIs von Drittanbietern und die Arbeit mit Marketingdatenstrukturen (z. B. Salesforce, HubSpot, GA, Marketo).

•
Verfügen Sie über fundierte analytische Fähigkeiten und Erfahrung beim Erstellen von Performance-Dashboards und Reporting für bereitgestellte Automatisierungen.

•
Seien Sie ein klarer Kommunikator, der nicht-technischen Stakeholdern erklären kann, was eine Automatisierung tut – und warum sie wichtig ist – und ihre Anforderungen in präzise technische Spezifikationen übersetzen kann.

•
Bringen Sie intellektuelle Neugier und eine Voreingenommenheit zum Aufbau - Sie bleiben auf dem neuesten Stand der sich schnell bewegenden KI-Landschaft und bringen dieses Wissen in Ihre tägliche Arbeit.

•
Halten Sie einen Bachelor-Abschluss in Marketing, Business, Informatik oder einem verwandten Bereich.

In-Office-Kultur

Das ist unsere Absicht. Wir glauben, dass die besten Teams gemeinsam im Raum gebaut werden. Drei Ankertage - montags, dienstags und donnerstags - schaffen den Kollaborationsrhythmus, der ein Hub-Office wert macht.

Die Kandidaten müssen wirklich an dem Ort ansässig sein, an dem die Rolle veröffentlicht wird - wenn Sie heute nicht dort sind, unterstützen wir gerne den Umzug für die richtige Person.

Wir legen Wert auf Vielfalt, Gerechtigkeit und Inklusion

Bei Sonar glauben wir, dass unsere Vielfalt unsere Stärke ist. Wir sind ein globales Unternehmen, das unterschiedliche Hintergründe, Perspektiven und Kulturen schätzt und respektiert. Wir setzen uns für ein vielfältiges und integratives Arbeitsumfeld ein, in dem sich jeder geschätzt und befähigt fühlt, sein Bestes zu geben. Wir sind stolz darauf, ein Arbeitgeber für Chancengleichheit zu sein und begrüßen alle qualifizierten Bewerber, unabhängig von Rasse, Hautfarbe, Religion, Geschlecht, Geschlechtsidentität oder -ausdruck, sexueller Orientierung, nationaler Herkunft, Genetik, Behinderung, Alter oder Veteranenstatus.

Wenn Sie eine Unterkunft benötigen, kontaktieren Sie uns bitte unter hiring@sonarsource.com.

Alle Beschäftigungsangebote bei Sonar hängen von den Ergebnissen einer umfassenden Hintergrundprüfung und Referenzüberprüfung ab, die vor dem Startdatum durchgeführt wurden.

Bewerbungen, die über Agenturen oder Drittanbieter eingereicht werden, werden nicht berücksichtigt.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Qui est Sonar ?

Sonar dirige l'avenir du développement de logiciels centrés sur les agents. En tant que leader de l'examen et de la vérification des codes d'IA, nous résolvons un problème critique : veiller à ce que les logiciels générés par les développeurs assistés par AI ou les agents autonomes soient fiables, sécurisés et durables.

En s'intégrant parfaitement avec Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini et Devin, nous aidons plus de 75% des logiciels de construction Fortune 100 fiables, conformes. Les clients qui utilisent Sonar sont 44 % moins susceptibles de signaler une panne en raison du code généré par l'IA.

Nous croyons que la vérification du code est le lien manquant essentiel dans le cycle de développement Agent-Centric (AC/DC). Les géants de l'industrie comme Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca et Ford Motor Company comptent sur nous pour fournir un examen indépendant, explicable, cohérent et la gouvernance de leur code généré par l'IA via des produits comme:

•
SonarQube: Le monde est la principale plate-forme de révision et de vérification de code AI.

•
SonarQube Foundation Agent: En ce moment, les classements pour la réparation de logiciels mandataires.

•
SonarSweep & Sonar Contexte Augmentation : fournir le contexte de qualité entreprise et les agents de contraintes doivent être vraiment efficaces.

Notre équipe opère à travers des centres mondiaux à Austin, Bochum, Dubaï, Genève, Londres, Singapour, Tokyo et Washington D.C. Nous bougeons avec un état d'esprit que nous appelons CODE:

•
Engagement envers nos clients et notre communauté.

•
Obsédé par la qualité.

•
Délibérer dans nos décisions.

•
Efficace comme une seule équipe.

Avec plus de 400 M$ de revenus et une croissance rentable et rapide, nous construisons l'épine dorsale de la révolution logicielle de l'IA. Si vous avez faim d'avoir un impact, voulez construire à un rythme rapide, et prêt à travailler à l'avant-garde de l'IA, nous voulons entendre de vous.

Description de la position

En tant qu'Ingénieur Marketing AI de Sonar, vous concevez, construisez et maintenez les agents AI et les workflows automatisés qui multiplient l'impact de la fonction marketing. Vous passez du temps avec les intervenants du marketing pour comprendre leur travail en profondeur, identifier où l'automatisation crée un réel levier, puis construire et itérer jusqu'à ce qu'il fonctionne bien. Vous produisez des rapports clairs sur l'efficacité et l'impact, en gardant le leadership du marketing informé sur ce que les automatismes fournissent réellement.

La meilleure personne pour ce rôle pourrait être un vétéran des opérations de marketing qui s'est appris à construire avec l'IA, ou un ingénieur d'automatisation qui a approfondi sur comment le marketing fonctionne réellement. De toute façon, ce qui compte, c'est la combinaison: vous comprenez les processus marketing de l'intérieur, et vous pouvez construire des automatismes fiables qui rendent ces processus plus rapides, plus intelligents et plus évolutives.

Ce que vous ferez

•
Planifier et prioriser les possibilités d'automatisation : Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes de marketing pour développer une compréhension approfondie de leurs processus quotidiens – identifier où les agents d'IA et les workflows automatisés peuvent éliminer le travail manuel, réduire les erreurs ou débloquer des capacités qui n'étaient pas auparavant possibles.

•
Concevoir et construire des agents d'IA : Développer des agents d'IA et des workflows automatisés qui simplifient les processus de marketing, de la production de contenu et des opérations de campagne à la production de rapports, à l'acheminement et à la personnalisation à grande échelle.

•
Déployer et maintenir les automatismes: Posséder le cycle de vie complet des agents déployés — de la libération initiale à la surveillance continue, au débogage et à l'itération — en assurant la fiabilité et les performances à mesure que l'utilisation augmente.

•
Produire des rapports sur l'efficacité et l'impact : suivre et rendre compte des mesures d'automatisation des flux de travail - gain de temps, taux d'erreurs, débit et impact sur les entreprises - fournir régulièrement des tableaux de bord et des résumés aux responsables du marketing.

•
Restez à jour sur l'outil d'IA: évaluez en permanence les nouveaux modèles d'IA, les cadres d'agents et les plates-formes d'automatisation, en apportant un point de vue clair sur ce que le marketing Sonar devrait adopter, expérimenter ou construire.

•
Collaborez étroitement avec le Marketing Tooling & AI Operations Manager afin de comprendre la pile d'outils existante, de s'assurer que les automatismes s'intègrent de façon fiable avec elle et d'encourager l'adoption de nouvelles capacités d'IA.

•
Assurer la qualité et la gouvernance des données: concevoir des automatisations qui traitent les données de marketing de manière responsable, en accordant une attention particulière à la qualité des données, à la confidentialité et à la vérification de tous les flux de travail déployés.

•
Documenter et activer : Produire une documentation claire pour tous les agents déployés et les workflows, et exécuter des sessions d'activation internes pour aider l'équipe marketing à comprendre et utiliser efficacement ce que vous avez construit.

Expérience et qualifications

•
Avoir plus de 3 ans d'expérience dans les opérations de marketing, l'ingénierie d'automatisation ou un rôle étroitement lié, avec une expérience de construction de workflows ou d'automatisations qui a amélioré de façon mesurable l'efficacité de l'équipe.

•
Avoir une connaissance approfondie et pratique des processus et des outils de marketing, y compris le CRM (Salesforce), l'automatisation du marketing, les opérations de campagne, l'analyse et les flux de travail de contenu. Un praticien du marketing qui est devenu l'automatisation du bâtiment est un bon choix.

•
Être expérimenté avec des plates-formes d'automatisation sans code/faible code (p. ex., Make, Zapier, n8n) et confortablement les étendre avec scriptage au besoin (Python et/ou JavaScript).

•
Avoir une connaissance pratique des cadres d'agents d'IA (p. ex. LangChain, Claude Agent SDK, OpenAI Assistants) ou une capacité et un appétit démontrés pour se lancer rapidement.

•
Être expérimentée dans l'intégration avec des API tierces et travailler avec des structures de données de marketing (par exemple, Salesforce, HubSpot, GA, Marketo).

•
Avoir de solides compétences analytiques et de l'expérience en matière d'élaboration de tableaux de bord et de rapports de performance pour les automatisations déployées.

•
Être un communicateur clair qui peut expliquer ce qu'une automatisation fait — et pourquoi elle importe — aux acteurs non techniques, et traduire leurs exigences en spécifications techniques précises.

•
Apportez une curiosité intellectuelle et un biais à construire — vous restez à jour sur le paysage de l'IA qui évolue rapidement et apportez cette connaissance dans votre travail quotidien.

•
Être titulaire d'un baccalauréat en marketing, en affaires, en informatique ou dans un domaine connexe.

Culture interne

Nous sommes intentionnels. Nous croyons que les meilleures équipes sont construites dans la pièce ensemble. Trois jours d'ancrage — les lundis, les mardis et les jeudis — créent le rythme de collaboration qui rend un bureau central intéressant.

Les candidats doivent être véritablement basés dans l'endroit où le rôle est affiché — si ce n'est pas là où vous êtes aujourd'hui, nous sommes heureux de soutenir la réinstallation pour la bonne personne.

Nous apprécions la diversité, l'équité et l'inclusion

Chez Sonar, nous croyons que notre diversité est notre force. Nous sommes une entreprise mondiale qui valorise et respecte différents horizons, perspectives et cultures. Nous sommes déterminés à favoriser un environnement de travail diversifié et inclusif où chacun se sent valorisé et habilité à contribuer le mieux possible. Nous sommes fiers d'être un employeur sur un pied d'égalité et d'accueillir tous les candidats qualifiés, peu importe la race, la couleur, la religion, le sexe, l'identité ou l'expression de genre, l'orientation sexuelle, l'origine nationale, la génétique, le handicap, l'âge ou le statut de vétéran.

Si vous avez besoin d'un logement, veuillez communiquer avec nous à l'adresse suivante : embauche@sonarsource.com.

Toutes les offres d'emploi chez Sonar dépendent des résultats d'une vérification complète des antécédents et des références effectuée avant la date de début.

• SonarQube: The world’s leading AI code review and verification platform.

• SonarQube Foundation Agent: Currently topping the leaderboards for agentic software repair.

• SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Providing the enterprise-grade context and constraints agents need to be truly effective.

• Committed to our customers and community.

• Obsessed with quality.

• Deliberate in our decisions.

With over $400M in revenue and profitable, fast-paced growth, we are building the backbone of the AI software revolution. If you’re hungry to have an impact, want to build at a fast pace, and ready to work at the forefront of AI, we want to hear from you.

Position description

We are still at the beginning of our growth journey, so we are putting new processes, technologies, and tools in place on a continuous basis. Your role is a pivotal engineering contributor to the tooling and services to automate and enhance the software development lifecycle, empowering our fellow SonarSourcers to deliver with speed, confidence, and security. You would be a member of a team that delivers solutions across all of our 5 offices: Austin (Texas, US), Geneva (Switzerland), Bochum (Germany) and Singapore.

As a Major Incident Manager, you use and create automation tools to monitor and observe production infrastructure services both on premises and in the cloud. You are allergic to repetitive tasks, preferring to maximize automation and reliability. You are expert in change management, infrastructure management, system support, and configuration management.

What you will do

• System Health Monitoring, Alert Triaging, and Error Budget Management: Dedicate time to monitoring critical security infrastructure (e.g., identity platforms, firewalls, compliance systems) and core infrastructure components. Focus on using and maintaining dashboards tied to Service Level Objectives (SLOs) , triaging high-severity alerts, and analyzing the current Error Budget burn rate to guide prioritization for the rest of the day.

• Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and Policy as Code Development: Spend the largest portion of time writing, reviewing, and testing code (e.g., Python, Go, Terraform, or proprietary tools) to automate the deployment, configuration, and security hardening of infrastructure. This involves treating infrastructure and security policies as software to ensure consistency and prevent configuration drift.

• Toil Elimination and Automation of Operational Tasks: Identify, scope, and implement automated solutions for manual, repetitive, and time-consuming tasks (toil) related to security patching, compliance checks, certificate rotations, or infrastructure maintenance. The goal is to continuously reduce the operational workload for the team.

• Security Pipeline and Observability Maintenance: Maintain and enhance the DevSecOps security tools integrated into the CI/CD pipelines (e.g., static analysis, vulnerability scanning, security configuration checks). Ensure the end-to-end logging, metrics, and tracing (observability) systems for both infrastructure and security tools are robust, accurate, and provide immediate diagnostic capability during incidents.

• Incident Response Engineering and Post-Mortem Action: Participate in the on-call rotation and actively engage in engineering solutions derived from post-mortems. This means turning incident root causes into preventative measures implemented via code, improving runbooks into automated actions, and reducing Mean Time To Resolution (MTTR) for future incidents.

Experience and qualifications

• Deep IaC Expertise: Professional experience provisioning and managing complex infrastructure using tools like Terraform or CloudFormation (AWS), or similar tools like Ansible or Puppet for configuration management.

• Cloud/Platform Experience: Hands-on experience with a major cloud provider (AWS, GCP, Azure) or managing large-scale internal/private cloud infrastructure.

• SLO/SLI Implementation: Practical experience defining, measuring, and reporting on Service Level Indicators (SLIs) and Service Level Objectives (SLOs) for critical services.

• Logging/Metrics/Tracing Stacks: Proven experience with modern observability platforms (e.g., Prometheus/Grafana, ELK/EFK stack, proprietary systems, or vendor solutions like Datadog/Splunk) for proactive issue identification.

• Networking: Strong understanding of core networking concepts (TCP/IP, DNS, Load Balancing, Firewalls, Proxies) sufficient to debug complex service connectivity and latency issues.

• Automation of Security Controls: Experience implementing security best practices via code, such as automated vulnerability scanning, configuration hardening, secret management (e.g., HashiCorp Vault), and key rotation.

• Identity and Access Management (IAM): Practical experience managing large-scale IAM systems (e.g., implementing least-privilege policies, single sign-on).

• Incident Management: Experience running or significantly contributing to post-incident reviews (post-mortems) and prioritizing resulting engineering work (error budget management).

Con oltre 400 milioni di dollari di ricavi e crescita redditizia e rapida, stiamo costruendo la spina dorsale della rivoluzione software AI. Se hai fame di avere un impatto, vuoi costruire ad un ritmo veloce, e pronto a lavorare in prima linea di AI, vogliamo sentire da te.

Descrizione della posizione

Siamo ancora all'inizio del nostro viaggio di crescita, quindi stiamo mettendo in atto nuovi processi, tecnologie e strumenti su base continua. Il vostro ruolo è un contributore di ingegneria fondamentale per gli strumenti e servizi per automatizzare e migliorare il ciclo di vita di sviluppo del software, consentendo ai nostri compagni SonarSourcer di fornire con velocità, fiducia e sicurezza. Saresti un membro di un team che offre soluzioni in tutti i nostri 5 uffici: Austin (Texas, USA), Ginevra (Svizzera), Bochum (Germania) e Singapore.

In qualità di Maggiore Incident Manager, si utilizza e crea strumenti di automazione per monitorare e osservare i servizi di infrastruttura di produzione sia nei locali che nel cloud. Siete allergici alle attività ripetitive, preferendo massimizzare l'automazione e l'affidabilità. Sei esperto nella gestione dei cambiamenti, nella gestione delle infrastrutture, nel supporto del sistema e nella gestione della configurazione.

Cosa farai

• Monitoraggio della salute del sistema, ottimizzazione e gestione del bilancio di errore: tempo dedicato al monitoraggio dell'infrastruttura di sicurezza critica (ad esempio, piattaforme di identità, firewall, sistemi di conformità) e componenti dell'infrastruttura core. Concentrati sull'utilizzo e il mantenimento di dashboard legati agli obiettivi del livello di servizio (SLOs) , il triaging di avvisi ad alta diseveranza, e l'analisi dell'attuale tasso di ustione del bilancio di errore per guidare la priorità per il resto della giornata.

• Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and Policy as Code Development: Trascorrere la maggior parte del tempo di scrittura, revisione e codice di test (ad esempio, Python, Go, Terraform o strumenti proprietari) per automatizzare l'implementazione, la configurazione e l'indurimento della sicurezza delle infrastrutture. Ciò comporta il trattamento di infrastrutture e politiche di sicurezza come software per garantire la coerenza e prevenire la deriva di configurazione.

• Toil Eliminazione e automazione delle attività operative: Identificare, portata e implementare soluzioni automatizzate per attività manuali, ripetitive e che richiedono tempo (toil) relative a patching di sicurezza, controlli di conformità, rotazioni dei certificati o manutenzione delle infrastrutture. L'obiettivo è ridurre continuamente il carico di lavoro operativo per il team.

• Sicurezza Pipeline e Manutenzione di Osservabilità: Mantenere e migliorare gli strumenti di sicurezza DevSecOps integrati nelle tubazioni CI/CD (ad esempio, analisi statica, scansione di vulnerabilità, controlli di configurazione di sicurezza). Assicurarsi che i sistemi di registrazione, metriche e tracciamento end-to-end (osservabilità) sia per gli strumenti di infrastruttura e di sicurezza siano robusti, accurati e forniscono una capacità diagnostica immediata durante gli incidenti.

• Incident Response Engineering e Post-Mortem Action: Partecipa alla rotazione on-call e attivamente impegnarsi in soluzioni ingegneristiche derivate da post-mortems. Ciò significa trasformare le cause principali degli incidenti in misure preventive implementate tramite il codice, migliorare i runbook in azioni automatizzate, e ridurre Mean Time To Resolution (MTTR) per gli incidenti futuri.

Esperienza e qualifiche

• Profondo IaC Expertise: Fornitura di esperienze professionali e gestione di infrastrutture complesse utilizzando strumenti come Terraform o CloudFormation (AWS), o strumenti simili come Ansible o Puppet per la gestione della configurazione.

• Cloud/Platform Experience: esperienza pratica con un importante provider cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure) o gestione di infrastrutture cloud interne/private su larga scala.

• Attuazione SLO/SLI: Esperienza pratica che definisce, misura e segnala gli indicatori di livello di servizio (SLI) e gli obiettivi di livello di servizio (SLO) per i servizi critici.

• Logging/Metrics/Tracing Stacks: Esperienza comprovata con piattaforme di osservabilità moderne (ad esempio, Prometheus/Grafana, stack ELK/EFK, sistemi proprietari o soluzioni di fornitori come Datadog/Splunk) per l'identificazione proattiva dei problemi.

• Networking: Forte comprensione dei concetti di core networking (TCP/IP, DNS, Load Balancing, Firewalls, Proxies) sufficienti per debug complesse connettività di servizio e problemi di latenza.

• Automazione dei controlli di sicurezza: esperienza nell'implementazione delle migliori pratiche di sicurezza tramite codice, come la scansione automatizzata delle vulnerabilità, l'indurimento della configurazione, la gestione segreta (ad esempio, HashiCorp Vault), e la rotazione delle chiavi.

• Identity and Access Management (IAM): Esperienza pratica che gestisce sistemi IAM su larga scala (ad esempio, implementando politiche meno private, single sign-on).

• Gestione degli incidenti: esperienza in esecuzione o contribuendo in modo significativo alle recensioni post-incidenti (post-mortems) e priorità lavoro di ingegneria risultante (gestione del budget).

Valoriamo la diversità, l'equità e l'inclusione:

A Sonar, crediamo che la nostra diversità sia la nostra forza. Siamo una società globale che valorizza e rispetta diversi sfondi, prospettive e culture.

Ci impegniamo a promuovere un ambiente di lavoro diversificato e inclusivo in cui tutti si sentono valorizzati e potenziati per contribuire al meglio. descriptionByLocale.en:
Who is Sonar?

Sonar is driving the future of agent-centric software development. As the leader in AI code verification and governance, we solve a critical problem: ensuring that software generated by AI-assisted developers or autonomous agents is reliable, secure, and maintainable.

Integrating seamlessly with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Gemini, and Devin, we help over 75% of the Fortune 100 build trusted, reliable, compliant software. Customers who use Sonar are 44% less likely to report an outage due to AI-generated code.

We believe code verification is the critical missing link in the Agent-Centric Development Cycle (AC/DC). Industry giants like Nvidia, ServiceNow, Booking.com, Goldman Sachs, AstraZeneca, and Ford Motor Company count on us to provide independent, explainable, consistent review and governance of their AI-generated code via products like:

• SonarQube: The world’s leading AI code review and verification platform.

• SonarQube Foundation Agent: Currently topping the leaderboards for agentic software repair.

• SonarSweep & Sonar Context Augmentation: Providing the enterprise-grade context and constraints agents need to be truly effective.

Our team operates across global hubs in Austin, Bochum, Dubai, Geneva, London, Singapore, Tokyo, and Washington D.C. We move with a mindset we call CODE:

• Committed to our customers and community.

• Obsessed with quality.

• Deliberate in our decisions.

• Effective as one team.

With over $400M in revenue and profitable, fast-paced growth, we are building the backbone of the AI software revolution. If you’re hungry to have an impact, want to build at a fast pace, and ready to work at the forefront of AI, we want to hear from you.

Position description

We are still at the beginning of our growth journey, so we are putting new processes, technologies, and tools in place on a continuous basis. Your role is a pivotal engineering contributor to the tooling and services to automate and enhance the software development lifecycle, empowering our fellow SonarSourcers to deliver with speed, confidence, and security. You would be a member of a team that delivers solutions across all of our 5 offices: Austin (Texas, US), Geneva (Switzerland), Bochum (Germany) and Singapore.

As a Major Incident Manager, you use and create automation tools to monitor and observe production infrastructure services both on premises and in the cloud. You are allergic to repetitive tasks, preferring to maximize automation and reliability. You are expert in change management, infrastructure management, system support, and configuration management.

What you will do

• System Health Monitoring, Alert Triaging, and Error Budget Management: Dedicate time to monitoring critical security infrastructure (e.g., identity platforms, firewalls, compliance systems) and core infrastructure components. Focus on using and maintaining dashboards tied to Service Level Objectives (SLOs) , triaging high-severity alerts, and analyzing the current Error Budget burn rate to guide prioritization for the rest of the day.

• Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and Policy as Code Development: Spend the largest portion of time writing, reviewing, and testing code (e.g., Python, Go, Terraform, or proprietary tools) to automate the deployment, configuration, and security hardening of infrastructure. This involves treating infrastructure and security policies as software to ensure consistency and prevent configuration drift.

• Toil Elimination and Automation of Operational Tasks: Identify, scope, and implement automated solutions for manual, repetitive, and time-consuming tasks (toil) related to security patching, compliance checks, certificate rotations, or infrastructure maintenance. The goal is to continuously reduce the operational workload for the team.

• Security Pipeline and Observability Maintenance: Maintain and enhance the DevSecOps security tools integrated into the CI/CD pipelines (e.g., static analysis, vulnerability scanning, security configuration checks). Ensure the end-to-end logging, metrics, and tracing (observability) systems for both infrastructure and security tools are robust, accurate, and provide immediate diagnostic capability during incidents.

• Incident Response Engineering and Post-Mortem Action: Participate in the on-call rotation and actively engage in engineering solutions derived from post-mortems. This means turning incident root causes into preventative measures implemented via code, improving runbooks into automated actions, and reducing Mean Time To Resolution (MTTR) for future incidents.

Experience and qualifications

• Deep IaC Expertise: Professional experience provisioning and managing complex infrastructure using tools like Terraform or CloudFormation (AWS), or similar tools like Ansible or Puppet for configuration management.

• Cloud/Platform Experience: Hands-on experience with a major cloud provider (AWS, GCP, Azure) or managing large-scale internal/private cloud infrastructure.

• SLO/SLI Implementation: Practical experience defining, measuring, and reporting on Service Level Indicators (SLIs) and Service Level Objectives (SLOs) for critical services.

• Logging/Metrics/Tracing Stacks: Proven experience with modern observability platforms (e.g., Prometheus/Grafana, ELK/EFK stack, proprietary systems, or vendor solutions like Datadog/Splunk) for proactive issue identification.

• Networking: Strong understanding of core networking concepts (TCP/IP, DNS, Load Balancing, Firewalls, Proxies) sufficient to debug complex service connectivity and latency issues.

• Automation of Security Controls: Experience implementing security best practices via code, such as automated vulnerability scanning, configuration hardening, secret management (e.g., HashiCorp Vault), and key rotation.

• Identity and Access Management (IAM): Practical experience managing large-scale IAM systems (e.g., implementing least-privilege policies, single sign-on).

• Incident Management: Experience running or significantly contributing to post-incident reviews (post-mortems) and prioritizing resulting engineering work (error budget management).

In-office culture

We're intentional about this. We believe the best teams are built in the room together. Three anchor days — Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays — create the collaboration rhythm that makes a hub office worth having.

Candidates need to be genuinely based in the location the role is posted — if that's not where you are today, we're happy to support relocation for the right person.

We value diversity, equity, and inclusion

At Sonar, we believe that our diversity is our strength. We are a global company that values and respects different backgrounds, perspectives, and cultures. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to contribute their best. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and welcome all qualified applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

If you need any accommodation, please reach out to us at hiring@sonarsource.com .

All offers of employment at Sonar are contingent upon the results of a comprehensive background check and reference verification conducted before the start date.

Applications that are submitted through agencies or third party recruiters will not be considered.

Ce que vous ferez

Se concentrer sur l'utilisation et le maintien de tableaux de bord liés aux objectifs de niveau de service (ALS), trier les alertes de haute gravité et analyser le taux de combustion actuel du budget d'erreur pour guider l'établissement des priorités pour le reste de la journée.

• L'infrastructure en tant que code (IaC) et la politique en tant qu'élaboration de code : Dépenser la plus grande partie du temps de rédaction, d'examen et de test (p. ex. Python, Go, Terraform ou outils propriétaires) pour automatiser le déploiement, la configuration et le durcissement de sécurité de l'infrastructure. Cela implique de traiter l'infrastructure et les politiques de sécurité comme des logiciels pour assurer la cohérence et empêcher la dérive de configuration.

• Élimination du travail et automatisation des tâches opérationnelles : Identifier, étendre et mettre en oeuvre des solutions automatisées pour les tâches manuelles, répétitives et chronophages liées au patchage de sécurité, aux vérifications de conformité, aux rotations de certificat ou à l'entretien de l'infrastructure. L'objectif est de réduire continuellement la charge de travail opérationnelle de l'équipe.

• Entretien du pipeline de sécurité et de l'observabilité : Maintenir et améliorer les outils de sécurité DevSecOps intégrés aux pipelines CI/CD (p. ex. analyse statique, analyse de vulnérabilité, vérifications de configuration de sécurité). Veiller à ce que les systèmes d'enregistrement, de mesure et de traçage de bout en bout (observation) des infrastructures et des outils de sécurité soient robustes, précis et permettent de diagnostiquer immédiatement les incidents.

• Ingénierie de la réponse aux incidents et action post-mortem: Participer à la rotation sur appel et s'engager activement dans des solutions d'ingénierie dérivées des post-mortems. Cela signifie transformer les causes profondes des incidents en mesures préventives mises en œuvre par l'intermédiaire du code, améliorer les runbooks en actions automatisées et réduire le délai moyen de résolution des incidents futurs.

Expérience et qualifications

• Deep IaC Expertise: Expérience professionnelle fourniture et gestion d'infrastructures complexes utilisant des outils comme Terraform ou CloudFormation (AWS), ou des outils similaires comme Ansible ou Puppet pour la gestion de configuration.

• Expérience Cloud/Platform : Expérience pratique avec un important fournisseur de cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure) ou gestion d'infrastructures de cloud internes/privées à grande échelle.

• Mise en oeuvre de l'ALS et de l'IDS : Expérience pratique de la définition, de la mesure et de la présentation de rapports sur les indicateurs de niveau de service (IDS) et les objectifs de niveau de service (IDS) pour les services essentiels.

• Logging/Metrics/Tracking Stacks: Expérience éprouvée avec les plateformes modernes d'observation (p. ex. Prométheus/Grafana, pile ELK/EFK, systèmes propriétaires ou solutions de fournisseurs comme Datadog/Spunk) pour l'identification proactive des problèmes.

• Réseautage : Une bonne compréhension des concepts de réseau de base (TCP/IP, DNS, Load Balancing, Firewalls, Proxies) est suffisante pour résoudre les problèmes complexes de connectivité et de latence des services.

• Automatisation des contrôles de sécurité: Expérience de la mise en œuvre des meilleures pratiques de sécurité par le biais du code, comme le balayage automatisé de la vulnérabilité, le durcissement de la configuration, la gestion secrète (p. ex., HashiCorp Vault) et la rotation des clés.

• Identity and Access Management (IAM): Expérience pratique de gestion de systèmes IAM à grande échelle (par exemple, mise en œuvre de politiques en faveur des moins favorisés, signature unique).

• Gestion des incidents : Expérience de fonctionnement ou contribution importante aux examens post-incident (post-mortems) et hiérarchisation des travaux d'ingénierie résultants (gestion du budget des erreurs).

Nous apprécions la diversité, l'équité et l'inclusion :

Chez Sonar, nous croyons que notre diversité est notre force. Nous sommes une entreprise mondiale qui valorise et respecte différents horizons, perspectives et cultures.

Nous sommes déterminés à favoriser un environnement de travail diversifié et inclusif où chacun se sent valorisé et habilité à contribuer le mieux possible.
